title: Strategic Operations Leader – STR/LTR Portfolio (High-Performance Lead for Pooling)
description:
The Mission: Turn Potential into Performance

We have a solid team of remote guest support, but we are currently missing a results-driven leader to unify them. We don’t need a "boss" to watch the clock; we need a high-level operator who can walk into a workflow, identify bottlenecks, and execute solutions immediately.



If you are a high-achiever who gets frustrated by mediocrity and thrives when given the authority to make things happen, this is your seat.



Why Top Leaders Join LuxoStays

Performance-Driven Pay: Your income is tied to your impact. Hit your KPIs and eliminate attendance issues to trigger aggressive bonuses and/or base pay increase.



Full Operational Authority: You aren't just following SOPs; you are rewriting them. You have the green light to overhaul team culture and demand excellence.



AI-Powered Efficiency: We lead with tech. You will be expected to use ChatGPT, Claude, and AI automation to outpace the competition and streamline guest services.



Growth Path: As we scale our San Francisco portfolio, your role and compensation scale with us. We reward loyalty and results with regular salary appraisals.



Your Objectives (The "Leg Work")

Strategic Team Calibration: We have a diverse team with varying work styles. You must be able to channel high-energy performers into productive outcomes while motivating and empowering quieter team members to take more initiative.

Zero-Tolerance for Misses: Take full ownership of guest satisfaction. If there’s an attendance or performance "miss," you diagnose the root cause and fix it—period.

KPI Mastery: Track, analyze, and pivot based on data. If the numbers aren't moving, you find the "why" and implement the "how."

Process Engineering: Use AI to automate the mundane so the team can focus on five-star guest experiences.



What You Bring

3+ Years of Real Leadership: You’ve managed remote teams and know how to hold people accountable.

STR/Airbnb Expertise: You understand the high-stakes, 24/7 nature of short-term rentals.

AI Proficiency: You use ChatGPT or similar tools to generate high-quality content, reports, and responses at 10x speed.

Unshakeable Work Ethic: Available for weekends and escalations. You lead from the front.



The Package

Negotiable Base + KPI Bonuses: We pay for results, not just hours.

Attendance Incentives: Significant bonuses for a "perfect" team record.

Rapid Appraisals: Performance and salary reviews every 6 months for "A-Players."

Standard Benefits: Paid leave after a year and long-term stability.



How to Take the Lead

Send the following to 

Resume (Highlight your wins and the teams you've scaled).

Audio Intro: A 2-minute pitch on how you use AI to stay efficient and how you handle accountability in a remote setting.

Subject Line: [Operations Lead] – Last Name, First Name



Final Requirement: To prove your attention to detail, include the name of the current Prime Minister of the United Kingdom at the end of your
.

title: Grant Writer & Grants Coordinator
description:
Grant Writer & Grants Coordinator

The Beacon Center | Remote | Full-Time or Part-Time



About The Beacon Center



The Beacon Center is a community-based nonprofit organization in Montgomery, Alabama, focused on expanding access to services that help individuals and families thrive.



Our work includes behavioral health and counseling, healthcare access and health literacy, food security, workforce development, adult education, homelessness services, violence intervention, reentry support, community partnerships, and other initiatives designed to address social determinants of health.



As The Beacon Center continues to grow, we are seeking a highly organized and skilled Grant Writer & Grants Coordinator to help identify funding opportunities, develop competitive proposals, manage grant deadlines, and strengthen our overall grants pipeline.



Position Overview



This is not simply a writing position.



We are looking for someone who can help build and manage a strong grant development system for The Beacon Center.



The ideal candidate will be able to research funding opportunities, understand complex grant requirements, develop compelling proposals, organize supporting documents, maintain deadlines, communicate what information is needed from leadership and program staff, and assist with post-award reporting.



You should be comfortable working with U.S.-based foundations, corporations, government agencies, healthcare organizations, and philanthropic funders.



Primary Responsibilities



Grant Research



Research foundation, corporate, local, state, federal, healthcare, and community funding opportunities.



Identify grants that align with The Beacon Center’s programs and strategic priorities.



Review eligibility requirements before recommending opportunities.



Maintain a pipeline of upcoming grant opportunities.



Provide brief summaries of recommended grants, including funding amount, deadline, eligibility, program alignment, required documents, match requirements if applicable, and a recommendation on whether we should pursue the opportunity.



Grant Writing



Draft letters of inquiry and full grant proposals.



Develop compelling organizational narratives.



Write needs statements, program descriptions, goals, objectives, outcomes, sustainability plans, evaluation sections, and organizational capacity statements.



Adapt existing organizational information for different funders rather than starting from scratch each time.



Ensure proposals clearly respond to the funder’s questions and scoring criteria.



Assist with grant budgets and budget narratives in coordination with leadership and finance staff.



Proofread and edit proposals before submission.



Grant Management



Maintain a centralized grant calendar.



Track application deadlines, reporting deadlines, award notifications, renewals, and follow-up dates.



Maintain organized grant folders and supporting documentation.



Create checklists for each application.



Notify leadership early when documents, signatures, budgets, data, or partner information are needed.



Maintain updated versions of commonly requested organizational documents.



Grant Reporting



Help prepare interim and final grant reports.



Track required outcomes and reporting requirements.



Work with program staff to collect program data and success stories.



Assist in maintaining documentation required by funders.



Help ensure grant commitments and reporting deadlines are not missed.



Funding Areas



The Beacon Center pursues funding related to:



Behavioral health and counseling



Mental health access



HIV prevention and healthcare access



Social determinants of health



Community health workers



Health literacy



Food insecurity



Homelessness



Housing stability



Workforce development



Adult education and GED programs



Violence prevention and intervention



Hospital-based violence intervention



Reentry and justice-involved populations



Youth and family services



Faith and community partnerships



Community development



Capital improvements and facility development



Technology and program infrastructure



Required Qualifications



We are looking for someone with demonstrated experience, not someone learning grant writing for the first time.



Applicants should have:



At least 2 to 3 years of professional grant writing, nonprofit development, proposal writing, or related experience



Excellent written English



Strong research skills



Experience writing professional proposals, reports, or funding requests



Ability to understand detailed Requests for Proposals



Strong attention to detail



Excellent organization and deadline management



Ability to manage several grants simultaneously



Strong Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Drive skills



Ability to work independently



Ability to communicate clearly when information is missing



Ability to accept feedback and revise drafts quickly



Strongly Preferred



Preference will be given to applicants with experience in one or more of the following:



U.S. nonprofit organizations



U.S. foundation grants



Federal or state grants



Healthcare grants



Behavioral health or mental health grants



Community development grants



Public health grants



Homelessness or housing programs



Workforce development



Human services organizations



Grant reporting and compliance



Developing grant budgets




 or similar U.S. funding systems



Important Expectations



Our organization moves quickly and manages several programs and partnerships simultaneously.



We need someone who:



Does not wait until the day before a deadline to request information.



Can identify missing information early.



Can turn an RFP into an organized application checklist.



Understands the difference between simply writing well and writing specifically to a funder’s requirements.



Can manage details without requiring constant supervision.



Can research before asking questions.



Can distinguish between a strong funding opportunity and one that is not a good fit.



Maintains confidentiality regarding organizational and client information.



Is comfortable working directly with an Executive Director.



All final grant submissions will initially be reviewed and approved by the Executive Director before submission.



What Success Looks Like



Within the first several months, the successful candidate should help us establish:



A comprehensive grant opportunity pipeline



A master grant calendar



Organized grant files



A library of reusable organizational narratives



A funding prospect list



A reporting calendar



Strong systems for gathering grant data and documentation



Consistent submission of high-quality, strategically aligned grant applications



Schedule



This position is remote.



Candidates must have some availability that overlaps with U.S. Central Time for communication, meetings, and deadline coordination.



The position may begin part-time with the opportunity to expand based on performance, grant workload, and organizational needs.



Compensation



Compensation will be based on demonstrated experience, writing ability, U.S. nonprofit grant experience, and results.



Expected range: $6.50 to $9.00 per hour depending on experience.



We are looking for a long-term team member rather than someone interested only in completing individual grant applications.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. A brief introduction explaining your grant writing experience.



2. How many years you have worked in grant writing, nonprofit development, or proposal writing.



3. Whether you have written grants for U.S.-based nonprofit organizations.



4. The types of grants you have written.



5. The approximate number of grant proposals you have completed.



6. Examples of grants you helped secure, including approximate award amounts when you are permitted to share them.



7. A writing sample or redacted grant proposal.



8. Your experience with grant research.



9. Your experience managing grant calendars and reporting deadlines.



10. Your desired hourly rate.



11. Your current availability.



12. Put the words “Beacon Grant Writer” at the beginning of your application so we know you carefully reviewed the posting.



Application Question



The Beacon Center provides counseling, healthcare access, food assistance, workforce development, homelessness services, and community programs.



If you were hired today, explain how you would identify and prioritize the first 10 potential funders for our organization.



We are looking for someone who can become an important part of The Beacon Center’s long-term growth and funding strategy.

Elevated Recovery is hiring a highly organized, persuasive, and emotionally intelligent Chat Sales Setter to manage conversations with prospective clients across multiple platforms.

* Ask thoughtful questions, identify needs, and guide qualified prospects toward booking a call

* Follow up consistently with new, old, and previously unresponsive leads

* Keep CRM records, notes, statuses, and follow-up dates accurate

* Make outbound calls when necessary to reconnect with leads or confirm appointments

Begin your application with the words **“CHAT SETTER”** and include:

Then answer this sample lead message in your own words:



> “I’m interested, but I’m not ready to book a call. Can you just tell me how much it costs?”



We are looking closely at your ability to write naturally, ask good questions, stay organized, and move a conversation forward.

title: Property Manager/Vendor Coordination
description:
Location: Remote 

Core Availability: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm Eastern Time (USA) 

Compensation: up to $2,000 per month 



SteelSafe Self Storage operates storage properties across the United States. Customers rent individual storage units and shipping containers from us to store their belongings, business inventory, equipment, and other items. 



Our properties are managed remotely. When a customer moves out, we need to quickly inspect, clean, repair, and prepare that storage unit so the next customer can rent it. 



We’re hiring a Vendor Coordination/Property Manager to own that process remotely. Your main goal is simple: keep our properties Rent-Ready and get units back on the market fast. 



What you get: 

A clear scoreboard and a role that matters. 

Direct access to leadership and fast decisions. 

A system-driven operation (we run on Asana). 

Performance bonus opportunity tied to ops execution. 

High trust and real autonomy. 

Real authority. You are not here to pass problems to someone else. You have the authority to solve them and improve the systems behind them. 

Freedom earned through results. We care about outcomes, not looking busy. Own the result, get the job done, then build systems so the job demands less of you tomorrow. 



What you’ll do: 

Manage the entire unit turnover process: after a customer moves out, make sure the unit is inspected, cleaned, repaired if needed, and ready for the next customer to rent. 

Manage local Boots-On-The-Ground (BOTG) contractors who physically inspect, clean, repair, and maintain our properties. 

Assign maintenance and repair jobs, follow up until they are completed, and verify the finished work using photos or videos. 

Keep sites customer-ready: gates, locks, cameras, lighting, cleanliness, and curb appeal meet SteelSafe standards. 

Handle property projects end‑to‑end (example: order a sign, coordinate install, confirm with proof). 



What you own (outcomes): 

Median Time‑to‑Rent‑Ready (TTRR) after move‑out. 

Rent‑Ready Unit % stays high and trending up. 

Work orders are dispatched quickly, completed quickly, and closed with proof. 

BOTG tasks are completed on time with proof, and contractor records and payments stay current. 

Publish a weekly scorecard that identifies misses, drives action, and holds owners accountable. 



The authority and tools you’ll have: 

You have the authority to improve the operation: turn workflows, proof standards, BOTG and vendor performance, inspection schedules, and the systems used to keep properties Rent-Ready. 

Asana as the operating system (tasks, checklists, proof). 



This role is a fit if you: 

Take initiative. Act fast. Identify problems, make sound decisions, and act within your authority without waiting for instructions. Clear your blockers fast. Move with relentless urgency.  

Own the outcome. Delegating work doesn't delegate responsibility. When contractors fail or projects stall, find another solution and see it through.  

Deliver results, not activity. We don't measure effort, calls, or hours worked. We measure problems solved and jobs completed.  

Demand excellence. Hold yourself, your team, and contractors to high standards. Done means done right, on time, and verified.  

Communicate early. Raise problems before they become missed deadlines. No surprises, excuses, or hidden problems.  

Fix the root cause. Don't just solve today's problem. Build simple systems that prevent it from happening again.

About the Business:

We are building a private vehicle rental operation that specializes in placing reliable economy vehicles with gig economy drivers on platforms like Uber, Lyft, and DoorDash.

This business is at the ground floor. We have one vehicle, an LLC, and a clear goal to scale to five vehicles in 90 days. There is no existing system, no active client base, and no lead flow yet. We are building that from scratch, and that is exactly why this role exists.

You are the person who helps us go from one car to a real operating business. That means creating structure where there is none, owning driver communication, keeping payment enforcement tight, building a renter pipeline from zero, and helping us move fast without building a mess.

 Marketplace, local driver groups, and WhatsApp outreach. You will create a backup driver waitlist so the car is never sitting idle waiting for the next qualified renter.

You document everything. You take ownership of your lane without needing a manager standing over your shoulder. You understand that at this stage, one unpaid driver or one idle week has a real impact on the business.



Experience That Helps:

Direct experience is not required, but strong preference goes to anyone who has worked in private car rentals, Turo support, HyreCar, rideshare fleet coordination, driver operations, payment enforcement, lead generation for local service businesses,
 Marketplace listings, or remote operational coordination. You should be comfortable in Google Sheets. If you have used GPS tracking systems or fleet management tools, tell us exactly which ones and what you did with them.



Hours and Pay:

20 hours per week to start. Must be available during CST business hours for overlap. Pay is $5 to $7.50 per hour depending on experience, execution quality, and fit.



How to Apply:

Then send all five of the following. Applications missing any of them will not be reviewed.

Two, the exact tools you have personally used for tracking, GPS monitoring, CRM, fleet management, or lead handling. Name them and tell us what you did with them.

nt until it is resolved? Give me the full timeline, what you say, how you document it, and when the kill switch becomes part of the equation.

What we offer

- $1,200–$1,800/month to start, set by your verified experience and test results. Pay is reviewed as the client roster grows.

- Long-term, full-time work directly with the US owner, paid monthly.

- You run the delivery side from day one. You're not one person in a large team.

- A paid test task for finalists, paid whether or not you're hired.



How to apply (applications without proof will not be reviewed)

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include all of the following:



1. SEO proof: 2 live links. For each one, send the website URL and/or Google Business Profile link, the city, and 2–3 keywords you ranked it for, plus a screenshot of the rankings or the Search Console performance report with the date range visible. Tell us exactly what YOU did and how long you worked on it.

2. PPC proof: screenshots of ad accounts you personally managed. Send at least one of: a Google Ads campaign overview, an LSA dashboard, or Meta Ads Manager. Columns must show spend, conversions/leads and cost per lead, with the date range visible. Also send one screenshot of Change History (Google Ads) or the activity history (Meta) showing your own user making changes. Blur client names, account IDs and customer details. Don't blur your own user name.

3. Answers to the 3 screening questions below. Write them yourself in a few sentences each. We are reading for your judgment, not for length.

4. Your weekday hours in US Eastern Time, any current clients or jobs, and your expected monthly rate in USD.



Please don't send logins or ask for ours. Don't send work you didn't do yourself; we verify links and screenshots. If you used AI to help write your application, just tell us. That's fine. Hiding it isn't.



Screening questions

1. Your own proof, explained. Pick one result from your application. In 4–6 sentences: what state was the account or site in when you started, which 2 changes made the biggest difference, and what changed afterward? Use the dates and numbers shown in your screenshot.

2. Live map-pack check. Search Google right now for "[service] near me" or "[service] [US city]" for any home service in any US city you choose, like "water heater repair Columbus OH". Tell us the search you used, the business in the #1 map-pack spot, and 2 specific reasons you can see on its profile or site for why it ranks there. Attach a screenshot of the results.

3. Budget call. A roofing company gives you $2,000 per month for paid ads and has never run LSA or Google Search. How do you split the first month between LSA and Search, what do you check before spending the first dollar, and what result after 30 days would make you change the split? (Fictional scenario; there's no single right answer.)



We reply to every applicant with complete proof within 3 business days.



— Justin Morris, Downpour Marketing

You’re invited to join a structured, supportive, and highly focused professional futures trading training program designed for individuals who want to develop real trading skill, grow inside a community of serious learners, and earn the chance to be evaluated for team placement.



This is not a traditional job posting with guaranteed employment. Instead, it is an opportunity to enter a professional‑grade training environment where you will learn the exact skills used by modern futures traders — and where top performers may be selected for a trading team position based on merit, consistency, and demonstrated capability.

Training is provided, and no prior professional experience is required. The program covers the core pillars of modern futures trading:



• Market Structure — understanding trend, bias, liquidity, and key levels

• Price Action — reading the chart with precision and clarity

• Volume Profile — identifying value, imbalance, and auction behavior

• Order Flow — footprint charts, delta, absorption, and execution confirmation

• Risk Management — protecting capital and building consistency

• Trade Validation — developing repeatable, rules‑based setups

• Quantitative Foundations — data‑driven decision making and performance tracking





All training is structured, guided, and designed to help you grow from wherever you are today.

You won’t be learning alone. You’ll join a community of likeminded individuals who are serious about developing skill, improving discipline, and building a future in trading.



Inside the program, you’ll have access to:



• A supportive group of trainees

• Shared study materials

• Group discussions

• Accountability structures

• A culture of growth, respect, and professionalism





This is a place where beginners and developing traders can learn without judgment — and where motivated individuals can thrive.



---



🎯 Team Placement Opportunity



After completing the training and meeting the performance requirements, you may be evaluated for a position on the trading team.



Team placement is not guaranteed and is determined solely by the program director based on:



• Skill development

• Consistency

• Discipline

• Understanding of the system

• Demonstrated readiness





This ensures that only individuals who truly excel and show commitment are invited to take the next step.



---



🧩 Who This Is For



This opportunity is ideal for individuals who are:



• Motivated to learn

• Serious about developing real trading skill

• Open to coaching and structure

• Interested in a long‑term trading path

• Excited to join a community of focused learners





No prior professional trading experience is required — just dedication, curiosity, and a willingness to grow.



---



🚀 How to Get Started



If you’re ready to begin your journey toward becoming a professional futures trader, you can move forward by choosing one of the following:



• Learn about the training structure

• See the skill requirements for team placement

• Begin the application process

I run an outsourced sales development agency. US software and technology companies hire us to book sales meetings for them. You'll make cold calls on behalf of these client companies, to other US businesses that fit each client's target market.

We work with business owners to understand their challenges and build solutions using AI and automation. This includes web apps, dashboards and connections between their existing tools to improve how their businesses operate.

AI has made software easier to build. We need someone who can turn a basic AI-generated result into an application that looks good, responds well and is easy to use.



You must understand how the code works and use your own judgement to plan the right solution. You should be comfortable questioning AI suggestions and checking its work.

Great results help us win more work - the better you do, the more opportunities will come your way. By joining early and proving your ability, you'll be well placed to take on greater responsibility as we grow.



𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀:

title: Sales Pipeline & Follow-Up Management
description:
About the role



I’m an appointment setter supporting existing students in an Amazon reselling education company. I help identify students who may benefit from additional one-on-one coaching or VA support.



I’m looking for an organized assistant who can manage follow-ups, keep my pipeline accurate, and prepare my highest-priority calls for the next day.



This is primarily a CRM organization and written follow-up role. It is not an Amazon product-sourcing job, a cold-calling role, or a sales-closing position.



What you will do



•Review student records in GoHighLevel and our custom student hub.



•Prepare a prioritized list of 5–10 qualified students for the next day's calls when enough suitable opportunities are available. Flag shortfalls rather than adding unqualified people.



•Include a brief reason for each priority, the previous conversation, and the recommended next step.



•Send approved written follow-ups and keep responses organized.



•Track people who never booked, missed appointments, or attended but did not buy. Record the reason and an appropriate next follow-up date.



•Keep contact notes, pipeline stages, and tasks accurate. Flag students who need customer support rather than a sales conversation.



•Send a short end-of-day update covering tomorrow's calls, important replies, and anything needing my decision.



We already have information about students' curriculum progress, goals, and self-reported financial readiness. You will use the available information and our qualification guidelines, not guess or pressure students.



What we are looking for



You should write clear English messages, follow through on tasks, and be comfortable organizing information in a CRM. You must be able to explain why one student should be contacted before another.



Hands-on GoHighLevel experience is preferred. Experience with another CRM, customer support, appointment-setting support, or sales administration is also relevant. We can train you on our student hub and process.



You need a reliable computer and internet connection, a practical plan for interruptions, and availability for the stated schedule. You must respect student confidentiality, contact preferences, and company access rules.



You do not need Amazon reselling experience, advanced CRM automation skills, or experience closing sales.



How to apply



Use the subject line: Pipeline VA — [Your first name].



Please answer these four prompts in order. Keep your answers concise; approximately 250–350 words total is enough. Include a link to your résumé or OnlineJobs.ph profile.



1. Relevant experience: Describe one example of managing follow-ups or organizing a CRM. What did you personally do? Which tools did you use? Be clear about whether you have used GoHighLevel. If you have no direct experience, explain a comparable tracking task you handled.



2. Availability and terms: Confirm whether the stated pay and hours work for you. Give your available work blocks in Philippine time, earliest start date, and your plan for internet or power interruptions.



3. Prioritization: Student A has completed most of the curriculum, has documented financial readiness, and asked two days ago about one-on-one support. Student B has similar readiness but explicitly asked us to stop contacting them. Student C is early in the course and needs help accessing lessons. Who should go on tomorrow's sales calling list, and what would you do with the others? Explain in 3–5 sentences.



4. Send a short video on why you would be a good fit for this position.



Shortlisted applicants will receive a paid, approximately 45-minute exercise using fictional student records. Finalists will have a short call to discuss their work and confirm the schedule. No access to live student data is needed during screening.



Applications that omit the requested answers or contain only a generic cover letter will not move forward.

title: Acquisitions Specialist – Texas Foreclosure Homeowner Outreach (2 Openings, Full-Time)
description:
Company: Nationwide Equity (Texas, USA)

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM-6:00 PM US Central Time, with a 1-hour break

Type: Full-time, 40 hrs/week, 2 openings, fixed salary + bonus

Start: Within 1-2 weeks of hire



ABOUT US

Nationwide Equity is a Texas real estate company. We work with homeowners and families dealing with mortgage foreclosure and tax foreclosure, and we've closed more than 65 foreclosure purchases over the past 4 years.



Selling isn't the only option we offer. Sometimes the right answer is helping the owner keep the house, through reinstatement, lender negotiation, a postponement or help from our attorney. Many of our properties belong to owners who passed away, so a lot of our conversations are with heirs and family members going through a hard time.



THIS IS NOT A HARD-SELL JOB

You won't be pitching cash offers or pushing anyone to sign. Your job is to start real conversations, understand what's going on in someone's life, and build enough trust that they want to keep talking to us. When a lead is ready to talk numbers, you hand them to our acquisitions manager.



Before each call, our system gives you a research summary on the property and the people connected to it: ownership, auction date, liens, heirs and a suggested approach angle. You use it to guide the conversation so it sounds informed and personal, not scripted.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call and text owners, relatives, heirs and neighbors connected to foreclosure and tax-auction properties in Texas

- Read the research summary before each call and use the approach angle to open the conversation

- Listen and find out the real situation: who lives there, who makes decisions, what's behind the foreclosure, what the family wants

- Identify the pain points (deadlines, money pressure, family disagreements, a house nobody can manage) and write them up clearly

- Talk with neighbors respectfully to help locate owners or family members

- Follow up and keep relationships warm over days and weeks, not just one call

- Log every conversation, note and next step in GoHighLevel (GHL) the same day

- Hand warm leads to the acquisitions manager with a clear summary of the situation



WHAT WE NEED

- At least 1 year of phone work for a US company, ideally real estate (cold calling, lead management or appointment setting for investors or wholesalers)

- Clear, natural, warm spoken English. People should feel comfortable talking to you, even on a hard day

- Patience and real empathy. You'll talk with people who are grieving, embarrassed or scared of losing their home

- Strong note-taking. Your summaries are what our team acts on

- Comfortable using a CRM (GoHighLevel preferred) and following a research brief

- A quiet workspace, a noise-canceling USB headset, fast internet (25 Mbps+) and a backup power or internet plan

- Comfortable working US Central Time hours



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with pre-foreclosure, tax-delinquent, probate or inherited-property leads

- Some understanding of how US foreclosure, tax sales or probate work

- Customer service, healthcare or collections background (people who are good with sensitive calls)



PAY

Fixed monthly salary, paid on time every pay period, plus a performance bonus. Long-term role with room to grow.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed.

1. Start your application with the words: "Texas Outreach"

2. Send a short voice recording (1-2 minutes). The scenario: you're calling the daughter of a homeowner who passed away. The house goes to a tax auction in 30 days, and she doesn't know about it yet. Introduce yourself and start the conversation. We're listening for warmth and how you handle it, not a sales pitch.

3. In 3-5 sentences, tell us about a phone conversation where someone was upset or didn't trust you, and how you handled it.

4. List the CRMs and calling tools you've used, and for how long.

5. Tell us your earliest start date.

title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location: Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: August



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:30 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:30 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

• Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

We are looking for an experienced and highly organized Real Estate Transaction Coordinator to help manage residential real estate transactions from contract to close.

Strong communication skills in English.

Ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines at the same time.

Experience with title processing, escrow coordination, or closing coordination.

Florida real estate transaction experience.

MLS experience.

You will do well in this role if you are:



Highly organized.

Detail-oriented.

Good at following up without being reminded.

Comfortable communicating with agents, sellers, title companies, inspectors, lenders, and internal team members.

Able to keep multiple transactions moving at once.

Proactive when problems come up.

Focused on getting deals to the closing table.

Cristian F.

JOB TITLE: Shopify Funnel Builder – Quiz Funnels, Landing Pages & GoHighLevel Integration (Full-Time)



ABOUT US

We're CORVIA, a fast-growing US heart-health supplement brand. We scale with
/Instagram ads, and we need a funnel builder who can launch high-converting pages FAST so we can test new offers every week.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build quiz funnels inside Shopify (multi-step quizzes that recommend a product and collect leads)

- Build unlimited product pages, landing pages, advertorials and listicle-style pages

- Set up full tracking on every funnel (Meta Pixel + Conversions API, GA4, UTMs)

- Connect Shopify to our CRM, GoHighLevel (lead capture, tags, workflows,
/SMS follow-up)

- Launch A/B test versions of pages fast (new headlines, offers, layouts)



HOW WE WORK TOGETHER

I provide the copy, images and design assets. You build, connect and launch.

But you must be the one who tells ME what's needed. If a page is missing a section, an image, a headline, a trust badge, or anything that will hurt conversions, you flag it right away with exactly what you need. You think ahead, spot gaps, and keep projects moving. You don't wait for instructions.



I AM NOT LOOKING TO BABYSIT.

This role is for someone who:

- Takes full ownership of their work from start to finish

- Solves problems on their own before asking for help

- Goes above and beyond what's asked, not just the minimum

- Gives proactive updates without being chased

- Is fast, ambitious, and hungry to grow with a scaling brand

If you need step-by-step hand-holding, this is not the right fit.



YOU MUST HAVE

- Proven experience building quiz funnels and landing pages in Shopify (Replo, GemPages, PageFly, Shogun, or custom Liquid)

- Hands-on GoHighLevel experience: forms, pipelines, workflows, webhooks, Zapier/Make

- Strong tracking knowledge: Meta Pixel, CAPI, GA4, UTMs. If it's not tracked, it's not done.

- A strong eye for clean, mobile-first, high-converting layouts

- Speed. You can turn a page around in 1–2 days, not 2 weeks.

- Strong English and clear communication



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with DTC / supplement / e-commerce brands

- CRO knowledge (heatmaps, page speed, conversion testing)

- Experience with Klaviyo, Triple Whale or similar



DETAILS

- Full-time, 40 hrs/week, long-term

- Must overlap at least 4 hours with US Central Time

- Pay: $6/hour to start, with raises based on speed, quality and results

- Paid test project before hiring

- Real growth opportunity: as the brand scales, so does your role and pay



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY. APPLICATIONS THAT SKIP THIS WILL BE IGNORED.)

1. Start your application with the words "HEART FUNNEL" so we know you read this.

2. Send links to 2–3 LIVE funnels or landing pages you built. At least one should be a quiz funnel if you have one.

3. Briefly explain how you connected one of those funnels to a CRM and how you set up tracking.

4. Tell us about a time you spotted something missing on a project and fixed it before anyone asked.

5. Tell us your fastest turnaround on a complete landing page.

6. Include your desired hourly rate.



We move fast. Show us what you can do.

description:
Who we are



RenderVibe (
) is a small, founder-led software business. Our product turns ordinary real-estate listing photos into professionally staged renders, and we sell to realtors, brokerages, home stagers, photographers, and builders in the US and Canada. We are a small team, we work from written playbooks, and we are hiring one part-time operations assistant.



The job



You will run daily operations for our social media accounts and support our sales outreach. The work is precise, repetitive, and important. Everything is done from written instructions — your job is to follow them exactly, report exactly what happened, and flag problems the moment you see them.



Your duties:



- Set up, warm up, and operate social media accounts (Instagram, TikTok,
, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube) for a set of content personas, following a written playbook step by step

- Post approved content on schedule and log every action with live links

- Research real-estate businesses online and record their publicly published business contact details — accurately, with the source page for every detail

- Send outreach messages using word-for-word scripts we provide (you personalize only the parts the script marks)

- Keep a tracking sheet perfectly up to date: every account, every post, every message, every reply

- Send a written end-of-day report every working day, in our format, with live links — including days when the numbers are zero



What we need from you



- You follow written instructions exactly. If a script says send these words, you send these words. If a step can't be done as written, you flag it immediately and keep working on everything else — you never silently improvise and you never quietly skip it.

- You are honest about numbers. If you did 18, you report 18. If something you did doesn't match what you reported, you say so in the same report.

- You never guess contact details. If a business has not published an
 address, you write "none" and move on. A blank is always better than a guess here.

- You report daily, with links. "Done" is not a report. A link that can be clicked and checked is a report.

- Strong written English. You will send messages to North American businesses in the founder's name.

- Reliable internet, your own computer, and comfort with spreadsheets, Google Drive, and learning new tools (we will train you on our systems).

- Social media account management experience is a plus. Real-estate familiarity is a plus. Neither is required — precision and honesty are required.

- Sales or outreach experience is a strong plus — cold outreach, lead generation, appointment-setting, or follow-up work for a business. It carries a higher starting rate (see below). Describe it in Question 8.



Hours and pay



- Approximately 20 hours per week, remote, Philippines-based

- Work is mostly async, but some posting and reply windows are tied to North American business hours — say in your application which hours you can genuinely cover

- Rate: $6 per hour, paid via Wise. Candidates with proven sales or outreach experience start at $8 per hour.

- Start: the selected candidate starts in the second half of October 2026; the exact start date will be confirmed during selection



How to apply — read this carefully



Answer ALL of the screening questions below, in your application. Applications that skip any question will be ignored — this is the first test of the exact skill this job runs on.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid trial task (about 2–3 hours, paid via Wise on completion) before any offer is made. The trial uses real samples of this job's actual work. We hire from the trial results, not from interviews alone.

title: WordPress Expert | Malware Removal, SEO, AI Search & Multi-Site Maintenance
description:
WordPress Expert | Malware Removal, SEO, AI Search & Multi-Site Maintenance



Job Type: Part-Time / Project-Based



Compensation: Negotiable fixed-price projects, with an opportunity for affordable ongoing monthly maintenance.



Location:  Remote, Philippines



ABOUT THE POSITION



We are a U.S.-based organization managing multiple business and nonprofit websites. We are seeking a skilled, reliable, affordable WordPress specialist who can repair, secure, optimize, audit, and maintain our websites.



We want someone who can independently identify problems, implement solutions, and improve our websites' performance in Google Search and AI-powered search platforms.



We are not looking for someone who only generates automated audit reports. We need someone who can actually perform the technical work, document completed fixes, and provide measurable results.



We have an existing detailed website audit that will be provided to shortlisted candidates.



This position will begin with one priority website and expand to additional websites as projects are completed and our budget allows.



 1. WORDPRESS SECURITY & MALWARE REMOVAL



Responsibilities include:



- Perform comprehensive WordPress security and malware investigations.

- Identify and remove malicious files, injected content, spam pages, suspicious administrator accounts, and backdoors.

- Investigate potential causes of security compromises.

- Inspect WordPress files, databases, plugins, themes, and administrator access.

- Implement security improvements to prevent reinfection.

- Review Cloudflare, DNS, hosting, and website security configurations.

- Set up reliable backups and verify restoration procedures.

- Implement website security and uptime monitoring.

- Review and help correct SPF, DKIM, and DMARC
 authentication issues.

- Document vulnerabilities discovered and fixes completed.



Security changes must be backed up, tested, and approved before implementation.



 2. COMPLETE WORDPRESS WEBSITE REPAIRS



- Diagnose and fix WordPress errors.

- Troubleshoot Elementor layouts and functionality.

- Repair broken links, forms, buttons, and navigation.

- Improve mobile responsiveness.

- Improve website loading speed and Core Web Vitals.

- Optimize images and website performance.

- Update WordPress, themes, and plugins safely.

- Review outdated or unnecessary plugins.

- Correct website content, layout, and technical errors.

- Verify that contact forms, calls to action, and lead capture systems work correctly.

- Create or improve website pages when assigned.



 3. COMPLETE WEBSITE PAGE & INDEXING AUDIT



Our initial priority website currently has approximately 584 page URLs listed in its sitemap, including 544 service and location pages.



We want these pages professionally reviewed, organized, and optimized where appropriate.



Responsibilities include:



- Inventory and audit every existing page URL.

- Identify pages that are live, broken, redirected, blocked, or returning errors.

- Check Google indexing status using Google Search Console.

- Identify valuable pages already receiving impressions, clicks, and traffic.

- Identify duplicate, outdated, thin, or low-quality content.

- Review location pages for legitimate geographic relevance and unique value.

- Check canonical URLs, meta tags, internal links, and sitemap entries.

- Review robots.txt and noindex directives.

- Identify pages that should be retained, improved, consolidated, redirected, or removed.

- Recommend improvements to important service and location pages.

- Preserve valuable SEO rankings and traffic during website improvements.

- Create a master spreadsheet showing every URL, current status, indexing status, SEO issues, recommended action, and completed work.



Important:  Do not delete, redirect, merge, or deindex existing pages without written approval.



We want to preserve valuable pages and improve their ability to rank, not automatically delete pages because of their quantity.



4. TECHNICAL SEO & LOCAL GOOGLE RANKINGS



- Perform full technical SEO audits.

- Fix crawlability, indexing, sitemap, and canonical issues.

- Optimize titles, headings, meta descriptions, images, and internal linking.

- Improve website architecture and service page structure.

- Work with Rank Math, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.

- Implement valid, relevant structured data and schema markup.

- Improve local SEO for businesses operating in multiple service areas.

- Identify opportunities for legitimate backlinks and business citations.

- Improve service-area content with accurate, useful information.

- Review competitor websites and keyword opportunities.

- Improve organic search visibility, relevant traffic, and lead generation.

- Provide monthly SEO performance reporting.



## 5. AI SEARCH OPTIMIZATION (AEO / GEO)



We want our websites technically and strategically optimized for discovery and visibility in:



- ChatGPT Search

- Google AI Overviews and AI Mode

- Google Gemini

- Perplexity

- Microsoft Copilot

- Bing

- Other relevant AI-powered search platforms



Responsibilities include:



- Audit current AI search visibility.

- Check whether important pages are accessible to relevant search crawlers.

- Improve content organization, clear answers, business details, and service information.

- Implement appropriate structured data.

- Improve consistency of business information across websites and relevant online profiles.

- Identify legitimate opportunities to earn trusted mentions and citations.

- Review competitor visibility in AI search.

- Track appearances in relevant AI search results over time.

- Recommend and implement practical AEO/GEO improvements.

- Provide reports showing completed improvements and observable visibility changes.



We understand that AI platforms and search engines control their own rankings and recommendations. We do not expect guaranteed placement.



## 6. MULTIPLE WEBSITE MANAGEMENT



We have multiple business and nonprofit website projects, including:



- A water, mold, and fire damage restoration company

- A nonprofit organization supporting children and families

- A business development and consulting-related project

- A developing educational and marketing brand

- Additional websites in the future



Our long-term goal is to have one dependable specialist overseeing technical maintenance, security, SEO, and website improvements across these projects.



We will begin with one website and gradually expand responsibilities based on successful performance and available budget.



 7. ONGOING WEEKLY & MONTHLY MAINTENANCE



- Monitor website uptime.

- Review malware and security alerts.

- Perform safe WordPress and plugin updates.

- Verify backups.

- Check website forms and essential functionality.

- Review Google Search Console issues.

- Monitor technical SEO health.

- Perform agreed minor website repairs.

- Maintain a record of changes.

- Provide brief weekly maintenance reports.

- Provide monthly SEO and AI search visibility reports.



 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



- Strong WordPress troubleshooting and development skills

- Elementor

- WordPress malware investigation and removal

- Website security

- Technical SEO and local SEO

- Rank Math or Yoast

- Google Search Console

- Google Analytics

- Cloudflare and DNS

- Hosting, backups, and restoration

- HTML/CSS and basic PHP troubleshooting

- Website speed optimization

- Structured data/schema

- AI search optimization

- Experience managing multiple websites

- Good written English

- Strong attention to detail



Experience working with U.S. local service businesses and nonprofits is a plus.



 COMPENSATION



We are budget-conscious and prefer *fixed-price project agreements rather than hourly billing*



We want candidates to propose affordable flat fees for clearly defined work, with the opportunity to establish a long-term monthly maintenance agreement.



The initial project will focus on one WordPress website. Additional websites will be added gradually.



Please provide competitive pricing and clearly explain what is included.



 HOW TO APPLY



Please answer every question:



1. How many years of WordPress experience do you have?

2. Have you successfully cleaned a hacked WordPress website? Describe your process and tools.

3. Can you inspect WordPress files, databases, plugins, and hosting for malicious code?

4. Have you worked with Elementor, Rank Math, Cloudflare, and Google Search Console?

5. Have you managed websites with hundreds of pages?

6. How would you audit 584 URLs and determine which should be improved or retained?

7. Have you improved SEO for local service businesses?

8. What experience do you have with ChatGPT Search, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, and AEO/GEO?

9. Can you manage multiple WordPress websites?

10. What is your fixed price for an initial website security and technical SEO assessment?

11. How would you price the subsequent repairs as fixed-price milestones?

12. What is your proposed monthly flat fee for basic maintenance of multiple websites?

13. Please share examples of websites you have repaired, secured, or optimized.

14. Are you available for a short video interview within the next seven days?



**IMPORTANT:** Start your application with the phrase "WORDPRESS SEO EXPERT" so we know you read the full description.



IMPORTANT SALARY CLARIFICATION:



The advertised $100/month is our starting budget for limited part-time website maintenance (approximately 5 hours per week).



Larger projects, including malware removal, website repairs, technical SEO, optimization of existing website pages, and additional websites, will be negotiated separately at affordable fixed project prices.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship, with opportunities for additional projects as our business grows.



We are looking for a reliable, skilled, affordable specialist interested in a long-term working relationship.



Thank you. We look forward to reviewing your application.

**Position Title:** YouTube Content Operations & Video (Real Estate / Relocation Niche)



**About Us:**

We are launching a high-growth, hyper-local YouTube channel and multi-platform media strategy ("Living in Virginia Beach") focused on real estate, relocation, and coastal lifestyle in Virginia Beach, VA. We follow a proven content playbook designed to capture high-intent relocation buyers through search-driven evergreen videos, curiosity hooks, and a systematic conversion funnel.



**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a detail-oriented, tech-savvy, and creative Virtual Assistant to act as our Content Operations & Video Manager. In this role, you will take raw footage from our filming days and turn it into polished, high-performing YouTube long-form videos, engaging short-form clips, optimized descriptions, eye-catching thumbnails, and ensure seamless distribution across platforms while tracking lead workflows.



If you understand YouTube SEO, love editing engaging video content, and can manage a structured weekly publishing rhythm without missing deadlines, this is the role for you.



-----



### **Key Responsibilities:**



  * **Video Editing (Long-Form & Shorts):**

      * Edit 1–2 long-form YouTube videos per week (target runtime: 15–22 minutes), maintaining strong pacing, clean cuts, b-roll integration, lower thirds, and audio balancing (wind/environmental audio management).

      * Cut 3–5 short-form clips (Reels, YouTube Shorts) per long-form video, featuring strong hooks, burned-in captions, and native platform formatting.

  * **Thumbnail Design:**

      * Design high-CTR, click-worthy thumbnail options per video following proven layout formulas (facial expression/emotion, 2–4 bold capitalization words, high-contrast visual anchors like maps or drone shots).

      * Manage A/B testing variations in YouTube Studio.

title: Video Quality Reviewer & Operations VA (YouTube Shorts | 800K+ Subscribers)
description:
Role: Video Quality Reviewer & Operations VA (YouTube Shorts)



Schedule: Exactly 4 Hours/Week (Fixed shifts: Wednesday & Sunday, 20:00 – 22:00 GMT+8)

Pay: $50.00 USD/month base retainer + $25.00 USD/month performance bonus (Total: $75.00/month for ~16 total hours = ~$4.70/hr). Bonuses awarded for 100% on-time delivery, zero scheduling errors, and accurate tracker updates.



---



ABOUT THE ROLE

We run a high-volume, automated YouTube Shorts media network. We are hiring a meticulous, detail-obsessed Operations & QA Specialist to act as the final quality gatekeeper before videos go live. 



You will not edit videos. Your sole responsibility is to inspect batches of finished Shorts from our freelance editors, reject any flaws with exact timestamps, schedule approved uploads in YouTube Studio, and keep our Google Sheets production tracker completely updated.



If you have a sharp eye for visual/audio glitches and can firmly hold editors to high standards, this is a consistent, low-stress, long-term role.



---



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Quality Control & Asset Review

• Review submitted .mp4 files at 1.0x playback speed during shift hours.

• Identify and reject common production defects: caption sync delays, audio clipping, pacing lag, frame drops, distorted AI anatomy/warping, and improper safe-zone boundaries.

• Provide clear, objective, timestamped revision notes to editors in real time.



2. YouTube Studio Management & Scheduling

• Upload approved Shorts to YouTube Studio with clean curiosity-driven titles.

• Complete monetization self-certification and accurately link related video elements.

• Schedule releases to exact GMT+8 publishing slots (11:30 and 19:30 / 21:30).



3. Pipeline & Tracker Coordination

• Log all pass/reject statuses and scheduling checkboxes in our master Google Sheet tracker.

• Monitor batch turnaround times (7 videos per batch) and escalate unexcused editor delays.

• Immediately delete any upload triggering an automated age restriction, red monetization flag, or community strike.



---



REQUIREMENTS

• Flawless written English and direct, assertive communication.

• Proven hands-on experience navigating YouTube Studio (uploading, metadata, self-certification, scheduling).

• High-performance computer and stable, high-speed internet capable of streaming 2K/4K video without buffering or stutter.

• Strict punctuality: You must be live, active, and responsive inside our communication channels every Wednesday and Sunday between 20:00 and 22:00 GMT+8.



---



HOW TO APPLY (Read Carefully)

Generic, copy-pasted, or AI-generated applications will be deleted immediately without review. To confirm attention to detail, start your application with the word "BLUE" as your very first word.



To apply, send a message answering these three questions:



1. What are the two most common technical mistakes editors make when formatting captions and aspect ratios for YouTube Shorts?



2. Briefly describe your experience managing YouTube Studio and maintaining Google Sheets production trackers.



3. Confirm that your system can smoothly play back 1440x2560 (9:16) video and that you are 100% available every Wednesday and Sunday from 20:00 to 22:00 GMT+8.

title: Meta Ads Specialist – Facebook & Instagram Lead Generation for Concrete Contractor (Hands-On, $6/hr, 10–20 hrs/week)
description:
ABOUT US



BMPC Concrete is a residential concrete contractor in Jacksonville, Florida. We install driveways, driveway extensions, RV parking pads, and larger concrete slabs.



We are hiring a hands-on Meta Ads specialist who can research, build, launch, manage, and optimize
 and Instagram campaigns on their own. This is an execution role. We are not looking for a consultant who only gives recommendations. We need someone who builds the ads, runs the campaigns, and fixes lead-quality problems.



COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE



- Pay: $6 USD per hour

- Hours: 10 to 20 hours per week to start. Additional hours subject to approval.

- Remote, flexible hours

- You must communicate reliably and respond promptly during agreed working periods

- Paid skills test for shortlisted applicants

- Long-term position for the right person

- Ad budget: $1,000 total Meta ad spend for the first 30 days (separate from your pay). You must be able to test and optimize with a limited budget.



THE REAL GOAL



Generate qualified residential concrete projects that turn into profitable jobs.



We do NOT want large numbers of cheap
 leads. Our past
 advertising produced dozens of estimates and zero sales. That is the problem you are here to solve.



Our target projects:

- Concrete driveways and driveway replacements

- Driveway extensions

- RV parking pads

- Larger concrete slabs



Our minimum desirable project is about 400 square feet, and typical starting projects are around $3,600. We do not want to spend money chasing tiny patios, small repairs, price shoppers, casual browsers, or people who aren't ready to hire a contractor.



You must understand the difference between a lead, a qualified lead, a booked estimate, and a paying customer.



LEAD QUALIFICATION – THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS JOB



You will design practical ways to filter prospects BEFORE we schedule estimates, based on:

- Project type

- Approximate project size

- Project location

- Property ownership or authority to approve the work

- Budget and willingness to spend roughly $3,600 or more

- Timeline to start

- Whether they're ready to hire or just researching prices



You should be comfortable testing qualification through Instant Forms (with conditional questions), Messenger, and landing pages. The target is fewer wasted estimates while keeping enough volume to produce profitable jobs.



COMPETITIVE RESEARCH: EYEFLY DIGITAL



A major part of this role is studying EyeFly Digital (
), an agency specializing in Meta lead generation for concrete, foundation repair, crawlspace, and waterproofing contractors.



Using Meta Ad Library, case studies, and social media, you will study their publicly visible client campaigns and identify what makes them work:

- Short-form video hooks and creative structure

- Jobsite footage and before-and-after transformations

- Direct-response copywriting

- Offers and calls to action

- Testing and optimization approach

- Lead qualification through Messenger, forms, or landing pages



The goal is to build original BMPC campaigns inspired by proven strategies, not to copy anyone's content. We want someone who can analyze competitors and then come up with their own ideas.



REQUIRED SKILLS



Strong practical experience with:

- Meta Ads Manager and campaign setup

-
 and Instagram lead generation

- Instant Forms with qualification questions

- Messenger ads and automated conversations

- Short-form video ads for Reels and Stories

- CapCut, Canva, or similar editing tools

- Video hooks, direct-response copy, and creative testing

- Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and basic conversion tracking

- Retargeting and optimization

- Meta Ad Library competitor research

- Lead quality analysis and reporting

- Getting results from small budgets



Strongly preferred: experience with concrete, construction, roofing, foundation repair, or other high-ticket home improvement services.



We supply real jobsite photos and videos. You turn them into ads that work.



YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS



- Research EyeFly Digital and other successful contractor advertisers

- Review our existing ad assets

- Develop at least three distinct ad concepts

- Create original video and image ads

- Set up qualified-lead campaigns with practical lead filters

- Manage the $1,000 test budget

- Monitor performance and make improvements

- Send weekly reports covering ad spend, leads, qualified leads, booked estimates, and closed jobs (where outcome data is available)



We value initiative, creativity, and independent problem-solving.



PAID SKILLS TEST



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid assignment built around one question:



"How would you generate qualified concrete installation leads with a $1,000 monthly Meta ad budget WITHOUT relying on the usual owner testimonial video?"



Every marketer suggests owner testimonials. We want to see what else you've got.



Your test should include:

- Two distinct ad concepts with strong opening hooks

- A practical campaign structure for a $1,000 budget

- Specific methods for filtering out small jobs, tire-kickers, and homeowners not ready to hire

- Your preferred lead capture and qualification method

- How you would measure whether the campaign is producing genuinely qualified opportunities



We don't expect free work or a full strategy before hiring. This test is paid.



HOW TO APPLY



Your application MUST include:

1. A brief introduction describing your actual Meta Ads experience

2. Examples of
 or Instagram campaigns you personally managed

3. Examples of short-form video ads you created or edited

4. Your experience with home improvement or local service lead generation

5. Your WhatsApp number, including country code

6. Confirmation that you accept $6/hour and 10 to 20 hours/week to start

7. Confirmation that you're available for a paid skills test



Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed.



IMPORTANT



Do not apply if you aren't prepared to respond when shortlisted. We have had applicants disappear after being selected. Reliable communication is a requirement for this job, not a bonus.



We cannot guarantee a set number of leads or jobs, and we don't expect you to promise them either. We're looking for someone who tests smart, reports honestly, and keeps improving lead quality.

GoHighLevel | Project Management | China Factory Coordination | Logistics



We are a growing U.S.-based pet products company looking for a highly dependable and proactive Wholesale Sales Admin Assistant.



This is not a basic VA position. We are looking for a true jack of all trades who can handle wholesale administration, GoHighLevel, factory coordination, project management, logistics, product development support, lead generation, and whatever operational priorities need attention.



You should be the type of person who sees a problem, investigates it, follows through, and makes sure it is actually resolved — without constantly waiting to be told what to do next.



What You’ll Do

- Support day-to-day operations of our Wholesale channel

- Manage and improve GoHighLevel, including CRM organization, pipelines, workflows, automations, forms, tags, and follow-ups

- Communicate with our China factory and supply-chain team through WeChat

- Coordinate factory requirements, product-development updates, samples, documents, and follow-ups

- Help manage factory audits, required documentation, deadlines, corrective actions, and buyer/vendor portals

- Monitor shipments, production schedules, container updates, logistics documents, and important deadlines

- Maintain organized trackers for projects, audits, shipments, product development, and follow-ups

- Respond promptly to
s, internal requests, factory questions, and buyer inquiries

- Assist with wholesale administrative work, reports, spreadsheets, presentations, research, and data organization

- Generate and research leads for U.S. independent pet stores, regional retailers, distributors, and major retail chains

- Keep CRM records accurate and make sure leads and opportunities do not fall through the cracks

- Provide clear progress updates and escalate blockers before they become emergencies

- Use AI and other tools intelligently to work faster and solve problems



What We’re Looking For

You should have experience with:

- GoHighLevel — strong hands-on experience is required

- Project management and handling multiple deadlines

- Administrative and executive-assistant type responsibilities

- Product development or supplier/vendor coordination

- Logistics, shipping, purchasing, supply chain, or factory operations

- CRM management and lead generation

- Google Workspace, spreadsheets, trackers, and documentation

- Working independently in a fast-moving remote environment

Experience communicating with Chinese suppliers or using WeChat is strongly preferred.



Mandarin/Chinese knowledge is a plus, but not required. Strong written and spoken English is very important.



Schedule

This is a full-time role requiring schedule flexibility.

We need someone comfortable with a split schedule, potentially:

~1 hour during Philippine daytime for China/factory communication

~7 hours during the night shift to overlap with the U.S. team

The exact schedule can be discussed, but you must be comfortable regularly communicating across both China and U.S. working hours.



The Person We Want

We value someone who is:

Proactive. Dependable. Organized. Resourceful. Detail-oriented. Tech-savvy.



If something is due, we should not have to repeatedly ask for an update.



If you do not know something, we expect you to research, use AI, check documentation, ask the right questions, and figure out the next step.



A task is not finished just because you sent an
. We care about follow-through and results.



How to Apply

IMPORTANT: Start your application with “WECHAT” so we know you read the entire post.



Please send your application via
 to:



Subject: Wholesale Sales Admin Assistant Application | Your Name

Please include:

- Your resume

- A short introduction

- Your experience with GoHighLevel

- Your experience with project management, logistics, product development, factories, suppliers, or wholesale operations
