If possible, include one example of a project where you had to coordinate multiple people, deadlines, documents, or suppliers and explain how you kept everything on track.

title: Senior Financial Paraplanner
description:
About Ensign Partners



Ensign Partners brings simplicity to complexity by integrating legal, financial, tax, insurance, and advisory expertise under one roof. Our clients receive one coordinated plan, one trusted team, and a clear path forward.



We are a values-driven firm built on professionalism, trust, and long-term relationships. Every role at Ensign matters. We believe exceptional client experiences are created through consistency, accuracy, and people who take pride in doing things the right way.



Position Overview



Ensign Partners is seeking an experienced, highly organized, detail-oriented Senior Financial Paraplanner to support our growing financial planning practice.



This role is primarily responsible for building, analyzing, updating, and maintaining comprehensive financial plans using eMoney. You will work closely with our U.S.-based financial advisors and planning team to turn complex client financial information into accurate, actionable financial plans.



You will be responsible for gathering and organizing financial data, identifying missing information, developing planning scenarios, preparing reports, and ensuring financial plans are accurate and ready for advisor review.



While this is primarily a behind-the-scenes planning role, you may communicate directly with clients to gather missing information, clarify financial details, and ensure planning information is complete.



This position is ideal for someone with strong technical financial planning knowledge, advanced eMoney experience, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage complex financial planning assignments.



Key Responsibilities



Build, update, analyze, and maintain comprehensive financial plans using eMoney.



Gather, organize, and evaluate client financial information, identifying missing data, inconsistencies, and planning opportunities.



Develop and model financial planning scenarios involving:



Retirement Planning and Retirement Income



Cash Flow and Budgeting



Investment and Portfolio Planning



Tax Planning Considerations



Life Insurance and Risk Management



Estate Planning Considerations



Business Ownership and Succession Planning



Education Funding



Wealth Accumulation and Distribution Strategies



Evaluate alternative financial planning strategies and clearly summarize assumptions, findings, and potential trade-offs for advisor review.



Prepare accurate financial planning reports, presentations, and supporting materials for client meetings.



Coordinate with financial advisors to incorporate recommendations, updated financial information, and changes in client circumstances into financial plans.



Communicate with clients as needed to obtain missing documents and clarify information required to complete their financial plans.



Review financial plans for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and potential issues requiring advisor attention.



Maintain clear documentation of planning assumptions, outstanding questions, recommendations, and updates.



Track outstanding tasks and ensure financial planning assignments continue moving efficiently through established workflows.



Maintain organized electronic client files and financial planning documentation.



Follow established systems, templates, checklists, and workflows consistently.



Manage multiple financial planning assignments while meeting deadlines and maintaining a high standard of accuracy.



Maintain the highest level of professionalism, confidentiality, and attention to detail.



Support additional financial planning and administrative projects as assigned.



Required Qualifications:



Five or more years of professional financial planning experience, including experience with complex client financial situations.



Strong proficiency in eMoney, with the ability to independently build, analyze, and maintain detailed financial plans.



Comprehensive understanding of financial planning principles, including retirement, investments, insurance, taxes, estate planning, and cash flow management.



Experience developing and comparing financial planning scenarios and evaluating alternative strategies.



Ability to identify potential planning issues, question assumptions, and recognize matters requiring advisor or specialist review.



Exceptional attention to detail, analytical skills, and organization.



Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Ability to interpret complex financial information and clearly communicate findings to financial advisors.



Ability to manage multiple planning assignments simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.



Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with a financial planning team.



Professional demeanor with a strong commitment to quality, confidentiality, and client service.



Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.



Preferred Qualifications



CFP® certification or equivalent professional financial planning credentials — a significant advantage.



Advanced experience using eMoney for complex financial planning and scenario modeling.



Prior experience working with U.S.-based financial advisors, financial planning firms, or wealth management organizations.



Experience preparing comprehensive financial plans for high-net-worth individuals, families, and business owners.



Experience with advanced retirement income planning, tax-efficient strategies, and estate planning considerations.



Experience analyzing business ownership interests, succession planning, and business-related financial planning scenarios.



Familiarity with U.S. financial planning concepts, retirement accounts, investment structures, insurance products, and tax considerations.



Experience with financial planning CRM systems and client document management platforms.



Strong ability to identify inconsistencies, missing information, and opportunities for additional planning analysis.



Ability to take initiative, solve problems, and improve financial planning workflows.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means our financial advisors can confidently rely on accurate, current, and comprehensive financial plans that are ready when needed.



You proactively identify missing information, follow up on outstanding items, and ensure financial plans continue progressing without unnecessary delays.



Planning scenarios are thoughtfully developed, assumptions are clearly documented, and findings are organized in a way that allows advisors to easily review, understand, and communicate recommendations to clients.



You take ownership of your work, consistently deliver high-quality financial plans, and become a trusted member of our financial planning team.



Why Join Ensign Partners?



Ensign Partners is intentional about building a workplace where people are trusted, supported, and held to high standards. This role is an important part of helping individuals, families, and business owners make confident financial decisions.



Joining Ensign means:



Being part of a mission-driven, people-first firm.



Working in a professional, organized, and collaborative environment.



Having clear expectations and the opportunity to take ownership of your work.



Working alongside experienced U.S. financial advisors and professionals.



Gaining exposure to comprehensive financial planning involving investments, taxes, insurance, estate planning, and business ownership.



Contributing meaningfully to a growing and respected organization.



Building a long-term career with opportunities for professional growth.



If you have strong financial planning experience, advanced eMoney skills, and are committed to producing exceptional financial plans with accuracy and professionalism, we encourage you to apply and become part of the Ensign Partners team.



IMPORTANT: Instructions When Applying



Please follow these instructions carefully. They exist to filter serious candidates.



1. Do NOT
 us directly.



If you
 us outside of this job post, you will be automatically disqualified.



2. Your subject line must be:  



Senior Financial Paraplanner at Ensign Partners



3. In your application, include ALL of the following:



A short introduction.



Your years of professional financial planning experience.



Your level of experience with eMoney, including how many years you have used the platform.



The types of financial plans and complex planning scenarios you have developed using eMoney.



Whether you have experience working with U.S.-based financial advisors or financial planning firms.



Your experience with retirement planning, tax planning, insurance, estate planning, and business owner financial planning.



Any financial planning certifications or professional credentials you hold, including CFP® or equivalent designations.



Which other financial planning software, CRM systems, and document management platforms you have used.



Your English proficiency level.



Your expected monthly salary in USD.



PAY WILL DEPEND ON LEVEL OF EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS.



Work hours will be full-time U.S. (Arizona) business hours.

title: Real Estate - Acquisitions Closer
description:
Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist (Remote)



ABOUT US

Price Real Estate Investments is a U.S.-based real estate investment company purchasing properties directly from homeowners across multiple markets. Our team works remotely to build relationships with sellers, evaluate opportunities, negotiate purchases, and move deals toward closing.



We’re hiring an experienced Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist who can confidently speak with homeowners, present offers, handle objections, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements.



This is a hands-on phone sales position. We’re looking for someone who can negotiate and close, but also stays organized, documents information accurately, follows through, and takes ownership of their work.



COMPENSATION

$10 USD per hour base pay, paid on the 1st and 15th of each month.



Monthly Contract Bonuses:

• Bronze: 2 qualified signed contracts = $500 bonus

• Silver: 3 qualified signed contracts = $1,500 bonus

• Gold: 4 qualified signed contracts = $2,000 bonus

• Platinum: 5 qualified signed contracts = $2,500 bonus



For each qualified contract above five in the same month, you may earn an additional $500, subject to ownership approval.

You receive the bonus for the tier you reach, not the sum of all tiers. Contracts count toward the month in which they are fully signed by the seller and approved by ownership as qualified and realistic. Ownership determines contract qualification and agent credit.



Quarterly Consistency Bonus:

Earn an additional $2,000 by securing at least three qualified signed contracts in each month of a calendar quarter. This rewards consistent monthly production, not just the total number of contracts across the quarter.

Quarterly bonuses are reviewed after the quarter ends and paid on the next regular payroll after ownership approval.



SCHEDULE

Full-time, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Central Time, following U.S. daylight saving changes.

This is a fully remote position requiring reliable availability, a quiet workspace, and a dependable computer and internet setup.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Speak directly with homeowners. Build rapport and gather accurate information about property condition, motivation, timeline, occupancy, ownership, and price expectations.

• Evaluate opportunities and present offers. Review comparable properties, help evaluate pricing, and present offers approved by our acquisitions department.

• Negotiate and close. Handle objections, negotiate within approved amounts and terms, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements using DocuSign.

• Stay on top of follow-up. Work new leads, scheduled callbacks, pending offers, and ongoing seller follow-up according to team priorities.

• Keep FreedomSoft accurate. Maintain clear notes, correct contact information, current statuses, and specific next steps. Document what sellers actually say rather than making assumptions.

• Work closely with our team lead. Participate in coaching and call reviews, apply feedback, and communicate problems early.



TRAINING AND ONGOING INTAKE RESPONSIBILITIES

Initial training typically takes approximately three to four weeks, depending on progress. It includes reviewing SOPs, shadowing a senior team member, practicing calls, learning our CRM, and receiving feedback.

After training, you will handle seller intake and lead processing while management evaluates your readiness to make offers independently. Approval depends on call handling, accuracy, follow-through, consistency, and response to coaching, not simply time in the role.



Seller intake and lead processing remain regular responsibilities after you begin making offers. This is not a closer-only position. Your assignments will vary based on lead volume, pending offers, and team priorities.



WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED

Sales ability: You can listen, uncover the real objection, communicate the value of our offer, and ask for a decision without sounding aggressive or robotic.

Ownership and reliability: You complete assigned work, keep commitments, and communicate when you are behind or need help. You do not quietly skip required work to catch up.

Attention to detail: You clarify conflicting information, preserve important details, and keep CRM records accurate so the next person can trust your notes.

Coachability: You bring your experience while remaining willing to learn our process, follow approved scripts and rebuttals naturally, and apply feedback.

Consistent follow-up: You stay professional and persistent through our approved calling, texting, and follow-up process, including when results are slow.



REQUIREMENTS

• At least two years of experience in real estate acquisitions or seller negotiations.

• Experience personally presenting offers, handling objections, and moving sellers toward signed purchase agreements. Be prepared to explain your own results and what other team members handled.

• Strong spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate clearly and naturally with U.S. homeowners.

• Familiarity with comparable sales, ARV, repair considerations, and purchase agreements.

• Comfort using CRMs and outbound dialers. FreedomSoft experience is helpful but not required.

• Ability to make 100 or more outbound calls per day when assigned to intake or outbound calling, while meeting the expectations for your assigned work.

• A reliable computer, high-speed internet, quality headset, quiet workspace, and a practical backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



WHY JOIN US?

You’ll have clear processes, training, coaching, and performance-based earning opportunities with a remote real estate investment team.

We’re looking for a long-term team member who wants to improve, contribute consistently, and turn seller conversations into qualified signed contracts.



HOW TO APPLY:

 your application to: 

Use the subject line: Real Estate Acquisitions Application - OJPH



Include both of the following:

Your résumé: Highlight your relevant real estate acquisitions, seller-negotiation, and phone-sales experience. A 1-2 minute voice recording in English: Briefly introduce yourself, describe your most recent relevant role and day-to-day responsibilities, and explain your experience speaking with homeowners, making offers, handling objections, or securing signed contracts. Be clear about what you personally handled.



Speak naturally in your own voice. Do not read a prepared script or use AI-generated audio. We want to hear how you communicate and learn about your relevant experience. Audio is sufficient; video is optional.



You may attach the recording or provide a link that opens without requesting access.



Applications missing the résumé or introductory recording will not move forward.

title: Markting Manager
description:
**Job Title:** HubSpot Marketing Specialist (B2B Lead Generation, LinkedIn & SEO)



**Type of Work:** Full Time

**Hours:** 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

**Salary:** $1,000 – $1,500 USD per month, based on experience

**Schedule:** At least 4 hours of overlap with US Central business hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CT) required



**About Us**



Solution Group is a US-based industrial wastewater treatment company. We operate treatment systems for large food, beverage, and dairy manufacturers across the United States. We're looking for a long-term marketing specialist to run our lead generation and help our sales team find and win new clients.



This is a long-term, full-time role, not a short project.



**What You'll Do**



1. **HubSpot marketing campaigns.** Plan, build, launch, and report on campaigns in HubSpot Marketing Hub. Manage lists, segmentation, landing pages, forms, and campaign attribution.

2. **Executive social media.** Run LinkedIn and other social profiles for our company executives. Draft and schedule posts, keep profiles current and on-brand, and track engagement.

3. **Lead gathering in ZoomInfo.** Build target lists of manufacturing sites and decision-makers in ZoomInfo. Enrich contacts and import clean records into HubSpot.

4. *
 nurture sequences.** Write and maintain
 sequences for warm and cold prospects. Track opens, replies, and meetings booked, and report results to leadership monthly.

5. **LinkedIn demand generation.** Use company and executive LinkedIn presence to start conversations, grow followers in target accounts, and surface sales opportunities.

6. **Website SEO.** Optimize our website for search: keyword research, on-page fixes, technical health, and content aimed at industrial buyers.

7. **Lead nurturing strategy.** Define how a lead moves from first contact to sales-ready. Set up lifecycle stages, lead scoring, and handoff rules with our sales team.



**Requirements**



- 3+ years of B2B marketing or lead generation experience

- Hands-on HubSpot experience: campaigns, sequences, workflows, lists, and reports

- Experience with ZoomInfo, Apollo, or a similar B2B contact database

- Experience managing LinkedIn profiles and posting for executives or company pages

- Experience with Buffer or a similar social media scheduling tool

- Working knowledge of SEO tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Semrush, or Ahrefs

- Excellent written English. You'll be writing
s and posts that go to senior US executives.

- Stable internet connection and a reliable backup (power and internet)



**Nice to Have**



- HubSpot certifications (Marketing Hub, Inbound, or Sales Hub)

- Experience marketing to manufacturing, industrial, or environmental services companies

- Experience setting up lead scoring and lifecycle stages from scratch



**How to Apply**



Send the following:



1. Your resume

2. Your expected monthly salary in USD

3. A **Loom(or alternative video platform) video (3 minutes max)** answering the question below. Make sure the link is set so anyone can view it.



**Video question:**

*"We sell wastewater treatment services to plant managers at large food and dairy manufacturers. Walk us through how you would use HubSpot, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn to turn a cold plant manager into a booked sales meeting. Be specific about the steps and tools you would use."*



Please be on camera for at least part of the video. We want to hear how you explain your thinking, not see a perfect script.



Start your application with the phrase **"Clean water, clean data"** so we know you read the full posting. **Applications without a Loom video won't be reviewed.**

title: Technical Customer Support
description:
The role



We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality.



You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to.



Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.



The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.



This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then d
 what to do and how to explain it to the customer.



We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.



If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.





What work looks like



You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable







Every day



⁠Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.

⁠Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.

⁠Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.







Delighting customers



Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast. and set them up for success.

⁠Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.

⁠Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.







Making support smarter with AI



⁠Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.

Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.

⁠Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.







Keeping the product solid



⁠Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.

Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.

⁠Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks 
s not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or
, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.







Running the week



⁠Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.

⁠Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.







Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack,
, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.



Requirements

Who you are

You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.

You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.

You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.

You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like loom.

Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.

You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.

You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.

You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.

Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.

Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.







A plus if you have

Have experience with customer facing, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.

Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup, . We can teach this, but a head start helps.

Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.

Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.

An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.







How we work together



You’ll work directly with me, the founder, and with our lead developer.



Working with me can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:



My replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something I wrote lands badly or isn’t clear, ask me.

My direction can change. I may say one thing, then something different a few days later as I learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.

I prefer information to be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if I ask.

I can stay frustrated about a problem until it’s solved. That's something I'm aware of and working on. You’ll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.

We often think fast and interrupt each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn’t for you.







This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn’t take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.



Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion we need your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.







Benefits

Contract type (full-time or part-time)

Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).

Start date: negotiable

title: Airbnb STR Virtual Assistant Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced Virtual Assistant to support the day-to-day operations of our fast-growing short-term rental management company. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on guest communication, cleaning and maintenance coordination, administrative support, and timely completion of operational tasks.



The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling multiple properties and competing priorities. You will be expected to take ownership of assigned tasks from start to finish, resolve routine issues independently, and communicate clearly when additional support or approval is needed.



Work Schedule

- Full-time, fully remote: 40 scheduled hours per week, 8 hours per day.

- Flexible with shift schedules: Morning shift: 8am - 4pm, Evening shift: 4pm - 12am, Admin shift: 10am - 6pm.

- You must be flexible with all the shift schedules, including weekends. The schedule follows U.S. Pacific Time.



Note that all assigned work must be completed personally. Delegating or outsourcing work to sub-VAs or other individuals is strictly prohibited.





Key Responsibilities

Guest Communication & Reservation Support

- Respond promptly and professionally to guest inquiries through Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, direct-booking channels,
, and phone.

- Support guests throughout their stay, including booking inquiries, check-in instructions, access issues, amenity questions, and checkout.

- Resolve routine guest concerns and complaints within established policies and approval limits. Escalate urgent, sensitive, or high-cost issues with a clear summary and recommended next steps.

- Review reservation details, calendars, and special requests to identify potential issues and ensure accurate information.

- Assist with guest reviews, damage claims, disputes, and platform support cases by gathering documentation and following up.



Cleaning, Maintenance & Vendor Coordination

- Coordinate cleaning schedules and confirm that properties are ready before guest arrival.

- Follow up with cleaners on completion status, turnover photos, missing supplies, and reported property issues.

- Contact and coordinate with maintenance technicians, handymen, landscapers, and other service providers.

- Source vendors, request quotes, confirm availability, and arrange approved services.

- Track cleaning and maintenance issues through completion, verify that the work has been completed, and keep relevant parties informed.



Administrative & Listing Support

- Create and update property listings, descriptions, photos, amenities, house rules, and check-in instructions as assigned.

- Maintain accurate property information, guest records, vendor contacts, and operational documentation.

- Complete assigned updates in Hostaway, PriceLabs, and OTA platforms according to established procedures.

- Monitor listing alerts, guest feedback, and account notifications; flag issues promptly and complete required follow-up.

- Assist with property onboarding and setup on additional booking channels by organizing information and completing assigned configuration tasks.



Task Ownership & Operational Follow-Through

- Manage your assigned inboxes, tickets, and task queues, prioritizing time-sensitive guest and property issues.

- Take ownership of tasks from initial request through confirmed resolution—not just forwarding messages or creating tickets.

- Maintain clear notes on actions taken, current status, deadlines, and next steps so others can follow the work without unnecessary back-and-forth.

- Provide end-of-shift updates covering completed tasks, unresolved issues, pending approvals, and follow-up needs.

- Follow company SOPs, flag gaps or recurring problems, and suggest practical improvements based on day-to-day experience.





Qualifications

- Proven hands-on experience supporting short-term rentals on Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, or similar platforms.

- Familiarity with STR PMS.

- Excellent written and spoken English, including confidence communicating with guests and vendors by phone.

- Experience coordinating cleaning, maintenance, or other property-related services.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple properties, conversations, and deadlines.

- Sound judgment and problem-solving skills: able to handle routine issues independently, recognize urgency, and know when to escalate.

- Proactive, reliable, and accountable, with a strong habit of following up without repeated reminders.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and learning new software, tools, and procedures.

- Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable computer and headset, and a quiet workspace for guest and vendor calls.

- Ability to consistently work the required Pacific Time schedule and provide the stated standby availability.

How to Apply



Growth Opportunity

Top-performing Virtual Assistants may have the opportunity to advance into a VA Manager role as the company grows.



Please submit your application and complete every question in the application form. Only applicants who complete the full form will be considered.

title: web developer
description:
Full-Time Web Developer – Shopify, AI Automation &
 Marketing (100% Remote)



Are YOU an experienced Web Developer with a strong background in e-commerce, Shopify, AI integrations, and automation?



Do you excel at building high-converting websites, developing custom solutions, and connecting different technologies to improve business performance?



Are you highly skilled in AI-powered automation,
 marketing systems, and technical integrations that help e-commerce brands scale faster?



If you answered an enthusiastic “YES”, then KEEP READING.



## About Us



We are Myra Biotech, a fast-growing hair-care e-commerce brand expanding across multiple European markets.



We're looking for a highly skilled, full-time Web Developer & AI Automation Specialist to join our team and take responsibility for our e-commerce development, technical integrations,
 marketing infrastructure, and business automation systems.



This is not a traditional web development position.



We're looking for someone who understands how an e-commerce business operates and knows how to combine development, artificial intelligence, automation, and conversion optimization to create scalable solutions.



You will work directly with our management and marketing teams to improve our Shopify stores, build high-converting landing pages, implement automated workflows, optimize our
 marketing systems, and integrate AI into our daily operations.



We already have existing e-commerce operations and marketing workflows, but we highly value proactive professionals who bring new ideas, challenge existing processes, and actively contribute to improving performance.



As the company expands, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a Lead Developer / Head of Technology role.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Shopify & E-commerce Development



- Develop, customize, maintain, and optimize our Shopify stores across multiple European markets.

- Build high-converting product pages, landing pages, sales funnels, and checkout experiences.

- Work extensively with Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify APIs.

- Develop custom functionalities and technical solutions beyond standard Shopify capabilities.

- Work with page builders and funnel platforms such as PageFly, Funnelish, Replo, or similar tools.

- Optimize website loading speed, mobile responsiveness, user experience, and overall performance.

- Identify and fix technical issues affecting website functionality, customer experience, or conversions.

- Implement upsells, cross-sells, subscription systems, and other revenue optimization features.

- Support multilingual and multi-market Shopify operations.

- Continuously improve our stores based on customer behavior, marketing performance, and conversion data.



### 2. AI Integrations & Business Automation



Artificial intelligence and automation are central to this position.



We're looking for someone who can do much more than simply use AI tools.



We want a developer who understands how to integrate AI into real business processes and create reliable, automated systems.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Design, build, and maintain AI-powered automations that reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.

- Integrate AI APIs such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar technologies into websites and internal business systems.

- Develop automated workflows using n8n, Make, Zapier, or custom-coded solutions.

- Create AI-powered customer service assistants, chatbots, and support automation systems.

- Automate repetitive tasks involving customer inquiries, orders, fulfillment, data processing, and internal reporting.

- Connect Shopify with CRM systems, logistics providers, customer support platforms, and marketing tools.

- Build AI agents and automated workflows capable of processing information and performing predefined business tasks.

- Develop internal tools and dashboards to simplify business operations.

- Continuously research and implement new AI technologies that can improve efficiency, customer experience, and business performance.

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain existing automations to ensure reliability and accuracy.



We strongly value someone who can independently identify opportunities for automation and turn those ideas into practical, working solutions.



### 3.
 Marketing, Klaviyo & CRM Automation



 marketing and customer retention are important parts of our e-commerce growth strategy.



You will be responsible for the technical development, implementation, and optimization of our
 marketing infrastructure.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Set up, manage, and optimize
 marketing systems, primarily using Klaviyo and Shopify.

- Build and improve automated
 flows, including welcome sequences, abandoned cart recovery, abandoned checkout recovery, post-purchase sequences, cross-selling, upselling, replenishment reminders, and customer win-back campaigns.

- Develop professional, responsive, high-converting
 templates using HTML, CSS, and Klaviyo.

- Implement customer segmentation based on purchase history, browsing behavior, engagement, and customer lifecycle stages.

- Connect Shopify customer data and behavioral events with Klaviyo and other CRM platforms.

- Use AI to improve customer segmentation,
 personalization, campaign workflows, and content generation.

- Build custom automations connecting Klaviyo, Shopify, OpenAI APIs, and tools such as n8n or Make.

- Implement automated
 sequences based on specific customer actions and purchase behavior.

- Support multilingual
 marketing workflows for different European markets.

- Set up and maintain
 deliverability infrastructure, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and domain authentication.

- Monitor and optimize
 performance, including conversion rates, click-through rates, revenue per recipient, repeat purchase rates, and customer lifetime value.

- Support A/B testing and continuous optimization of automated
 flows.

- Ensure customer data handling and
 marketing workflows follow applicable privacy and consent requirements.



Our goal is to build an efficient, automated
 marketing system that improves customer retention, increases repeat purchases, and generates measurable revenue.



### 4. APIs, Backend Development & Technical Integrations



- Develop and maintain integrations between Shopify and external platforms.

- Work with REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and authentication systems.

- Build custom scripts, backend functionalities, and internal applications when necessary.

- Use technologies such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, or similar programming languages.

- Integrate payment gateways, fulfillment providers, logistics platforms, subscription systems, and third-party services.

- Develop automated data synchronization between different software platforms.

- Troubleshoot integration errors and ensure stable communication between connected systems.

- Maintain clean, scalable, secure, and well-documented technical solutions.

- Implement appropriate logging, error handling, monitoring, and security practices for integrations and automations.



### 5. Conversion Rate Optimization & Performance Tracking



We want a developer who understands that the goal of an e-commerce website is not just to look good, but to convert visitors into customers.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Collaborate with our marketing team to continuously improve conversion rates.

- Build and optimize landing pages specifically designed for paid advertising campaigns.

- Implement and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Conversion APIs.

- Support server-side tracking and accurate marketing attribution.

- Analyze website performance and identify technical opportunities to improve revenue.

- Implement A/B tests on landing pages, product pages, and other conversion elements.

- Improve checkout experiences, average order value, upsell performance, and customer journeys.

- Optimize mobile-first shopping experiences.

- Identify and eliminate technical friction throughout the purchasing process.



### 6. Technical Innovation & Continuous Improvement



- Proactively identify inefficiencies and opportunities for technical improvement.

- Stay constantly updated on AI technologies, Shopify developments, automation platforms, and modern web development tools.

- Recommend and implement solutions that improve business efficiency.

- Take full ownership of technical projects, from planning and development to deployment and maintenance.

- Collaborate directly with management to turn new business ideas into working technical solutions.

- Build scalable systems capable of supporting our international expansion.

- Continuously improve existing workflows instead of simply maintaining them.

- Work independently, prioritize effectively, and deliver projects on time.



## Position Requirements



We're looking for someone with strong technical expertise and proven experience in real e-commerce environments.



- At least 3 years of professional experience in web development, preferably within e-commerce, DTC brands, or digital businesses.

- Strong hands-on experience with Shopify development, customization, and integrations.

- Advanced knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify Liquid.

- Experience working with Shopify APIs, REST APIs, GraphQL, and webhooks.

- Proven experience building AI integrations and business automation workflows. This is a key requirement.

- Strong knowledge of n8n, Make, Zapier, or comparable automation platforms.

- Experience integrating OpenAI APIs or similar AI models into practical applications.

- Working knowledge of backend development using Node.js, Python, or equivalent technologies.

- Practical experience with Klaviyo or comparable e-commerce
 marketing platforms.

- Ability to build, optimize, and troubleshoot automated
 marketing flows.

- Understanding of customer segmentation, CRM automation, and lifecycle marketing.

- Experience developing responsive HTML/CSS
 templates.

- Familiarity with Shopify page builders and sales funnel technologies.

- Strong understanding of conversion rate optimization, website performance, and mobile-first development.

- Familiarity with Git, version control, debugging, and deployment workflows.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently develop technical solutions.

- A genuine interest in artificial intelligence, automation, and emerging technologies.

- Excellent attention to detail, speed of execution, and a results-oriented mindset.

- Proficient English, which is our main working language.

- Ability to work within the CET/CEST time zone, especially for meetings and team alignment.

- Ability to take full ownership of projects without constant supervision.



## Strong Plus (Not Mandatory)



- Experience with Shopify Plus and custom Shopify applications.

- Experience with Funnelish, PageFly, Replo, or similar e-commerce funnel builders.

- Advanced Klaviyo experience, including custom events, API integrations, and sophisticated customer segmentation.

- Experience with Meta Conversion API, server-side tracking, Google Tag Manager, and GA4.

- Experience integrating Shopify with logistics, fulfillment, and payment processing platforms.

- Knowledge of databases such as PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase, or MySQL.

- Experience developing AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and AI-powered customer support tools.

- Familiarity with
 deliverability optimization and marketing automation infrastructure.

- Experience developing subscription systems, recurring payment workflows, and customer retention solutions.

- Experience working with multilingual e-commerce stores and international markets.

- Experience developing internal dashboards, analytics systems, or custom business tools.

- Knowledge of French, Spanish, or Italian.



## What We Offer



- Full-time, 100% remote position.

- Competitive base salary based on experience and technical capabilities, with room to grow as you bring value and results to the brand.

- The opportunity to take ownership of technical development for a rapidly expanding international e-commerce company.

- Direct collaboration with management and involvement in important technical and strategic decisions.

- A potential growth path toward Lead Developer / Head of Technology.

- The freedom to propose, develop, and implement new technologies, workflows, and automation solutions.

- Extensive opportunities to work with AI technologies, advanced integrations, and real-world automation projects.

- A fast-moving environment where speed, experimentation, technical quality, and measurable results go hand in hand.

- The opportunity to contribute directly to business growth through improved e-commerce performance and operational efficiency.

- A company culture built on Transparency, Speed, Continuous Improvement, Independent Thinking, Responsibility, and Collaboration.



## Who We're Really Looking For



We're not looking for someone who simply builds websites, installs Shopify apps, or follows technical instructions.



We're looking for a developer who understands how technology can make an e-commerce business more profitable, efficient, and scalable.



Someone who can look at a repetitive operational process and think, "I can automate this."



Someone who can identify a limitation within Shopify and develop a custom solution.



Someone who understands how AI, APIs,
 marketing, and e-commerce platforms can work together to create powerful business systems.



Someone who can build a high-converting landing page, connect it to the right tracking infrastructure, integrate it with Klaviyo, and automate the processes that follow a customer's purchase.



And most importantly, someone who is proactive, resourceful, highly independent, and genuinely passionate about technology.



We value professionals who bring solutions, not just problems.



## How to Apply



To be considered, please include:



1. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

title: Image Ad Creator | Ecommerce Static Ads and Swipe Research
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are an ecommerce company selling health, beauty, wellness and personal care products across international markets.



We are hiring an Image Ad Creator who can handle both competitor swipe research and static ad production for
 and Instagram.



You should be comfortable finding relevant ads, breaking down their hooks and visual concepts, and explaining why an idea is worth testing. You will then turn that research and approved creative briefs into original image ads.



You will work closely with a Creative Strategist, revise your work based on feedback and testing results, and keep your references and final files organized.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Search the Meta Ad Library and other approved sources for relevant competitor ads.

• Study the audience problem, hook, angle, offer, visual structure and product presentation behind each reference.

• Compare research signals such as active status, run duration, repeated variations, available reach or impressions, market relevance and product fit.

• Record the source link, what makes the idea worth testing, and how you would adapt it for our product.

• Create original static ads from approved swipes and briefs, including product benefit, comparison, testimonial and offer concepts where appropriate.

• Develop variations by changing the hook, layout, imagery, copy treatment or angle while preserving the intended message.

• Use AI tools where helpful, then manually correct inaccurate product details, labels, text, hands, faces, lighting and other visible errors.

• Check the correct product, market, offer, copy, image dimensions and file quality before submitting.

• Deliver creatives within the agreed deadlines and complete revisions based on strategist and media buying feedback.

• Keep swipe references, working files and final exports easy for the team to find.

• Ask for clarification when a brief, claim or visual direction is unclear or potentially misleading.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Relevant experience producing static Meta ads for ecommerce, dropshipping or DTC brands.

• Practical experience researching competitor swipes, supported by examples of your work.

• The ability to explain a creative concept beyond saying that it looks good or has high reach.

• An understanding that active status, reach, engagement and run duration are research signals, not proof of sales or profitability.

• Strong layout, typography, visual hierarchy, readability and product presentation skills.

• Proficiency in Canva. Photoshop or Figma experience is a plus.

• Practical AI image generation or editing experience is preferred.

• Careful attention to product packaging, spelling, copy, brief requirements and final exports.

• Clear communication, reliable delivery and a professional approach to feedback.

• Full time, long term availability, including weekends when required.



Experience with health, beauty, wellness, supplements or personal care advertising is preferred.



CREATIVE ACCURACY AND COMPLIANCE



You must recognize and flag potentially risky claims or visuals, including unsupported medical claims, guaranteed results, unrealistic timelines, misleading before and after images, aggressive personal attribute language, unsupported authority claims and celebrity or television personality lookalikes.



If a reference or brief raises a concern, clarify it with the Creative Strategist before proceeding. Do not assume that a competitor ad is suitable for us simply because it is active.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with SWIPE and answer all 12 questions below. Use specific examples from your existing work wherever possible.



1. How many years have you created static image ads for ecommerce, dropshipping or DTC brands? What did you personally handle?

2. Which products, niches and markets have you worked with? Include any health, beauty, wellness or personal care experience.

3. Walk us through your swipe research process, from understanding the product to selecting useful competitor references. What do you search for, and how do you organize your findings?

4. How do you d
 whether a swipe is worth testing? If two ads have different reach figures, what else would you compare? Explain what the available signals can and cannot tell you.

5. From your existing work, share one competitor swipe and the original ad you created from it. Include both links, explain what you kept and changed, and share a verified result only if you have access to the supporting data.

6. How do you identify the core hook or angle of a swipe and adapt it without directly copying the competitor?

7. Which design and AI tools do you use, and what do you use each one for?

8. Describe one ad you created using AI. What did you generate, what did you correct manually, and how did you check the product details and final output?

9. How many quality static ad variations can you realistically complete in a normal working day, including research, editing and quality checks?

10. What claims or visuals in a health or beauty brief would make you pause and ask the strategist for clarification?

11. Share your CV and portfolio. Prioritize ecommerce static ads, swipe references and original adaptations. Make sure the links can be viewed without requesting access.

12. State your availability, weekend availability, earliest possible start date and expected monthly salary in USD.



Applications that do not follow the instructions, answer the questions or provide relevant work samples will not move forward.



Shortlisted applicants will receive a combined image ad and swipe research test task after the initial screening.

title: Technical customer support (Tier 1) & Knowledge Base specialist – Linux VPS Hosting (Remote, UK hours, long-term)
description:
Technical customer support (Tier 1) & Knowledge Base specialist – Linux VPS Hosting (Remote, UK hours, long-term)



Hi! We're LumaDock, a UK-based cloud hosting company. Our motto is "technology with integrity, support with heart", and the second half is where you come in. We're looking for someone who makes people feel looked after, even when their server is having a bad day. The role is fully remote.



You'll help our customers through support tickets and spend the quieter hours improving our help articles and testing our tutorials. You bring the hosting support experience; we'll teach you our systems, our policies and how our team works. The things we can't teach matter most to us: empathy, patience and good judgement.



HOW WE WORK



* Support with heart: we want customers to stay because they like working with us, and every reply is part of that.

* Say it straight: clear answers, honest timelines and no promises we can't keep, with customers and with each other.

* Take responsibility: when something goes wrong, we say so and help fix it.

* Keep improving: we keep making our platform better, and we'll help you grow along with it.



WHAT YOUR DAY LOOKS LIKE



Tickets come first. We care about how quickly a customer hears back, how well you understand their problem and how soon it's resolved.

A typical ticket is a customer who can't log in to their server or its web console, a card payment that didn't go through, a refund or cancellation question, DNS or reverse DNS for a mail server, an extra IP address, an upgrade because the disk is filling up or a server that stopped responding.

Our VPS plans are self-managed: customers have full root access and run their own servers. You won’t log in to their servers. You’ll guide them through tickets with clear, safe steps they can follow, and check everything we can see from our side: billing, network, the host node and the web console. When something points to our infrastructure, you pass it to our technical team with a clear summary and tell the customer what happens next.

Customers write to us from all over the world, often in languages other than English. You'll reply in English, with translation tools we provide.



When the queue is quiet, you'll work on:



* Help articles: read our knowledge base, fix what's out of date and write new articles when you notice customers asking the same questions.

* Tutorials: follow our guides step by step on a real server, take screenshots and tell us where something breaks or gets confusing. You run every step yourself.

* Patterns: when the same problem keeps coming back, flag it with examples so the team can look at the cause.

* Learning: nobody expects you to know our systems in your first week. You'll have time to learn them properly and ask questions.



THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR



* Empathy and kindness: you read a stressed message, understand the person behind it and reply like a human.

* Patience: the third customer asking the same question gets the same care as the first.

* Good judgement: you know when to look into something, when a simple low-risk check makes sense and when to stop and escalate. We value this more than speed.

* Autonomy and responsibility: you organise your own shift, follow things through and keep your word.

* Confidentiality: you'll see customer information, and it stays inside the secure access we provide.

* Clear boundaries, kindly said: when something is outside our support, you explain why, point them in the right direction and never leave them with just “no”.



WHAT WE OFFER



* Fully remote, work from home

* USD 750 to 950 per month base, depending on experience, plus a 13th month bonus paid in full in December (USD 800 to 1,000 a month over the year)

* USD 35 monthly internet allowance

* 12 paid days off a year after probation, plus Philippine regular holidays (planned with us in advance)

* A 1-hour paid break in the middle of your shift

* No phone calls with customers. Support is fully written (ticketing system) and the only calls are video calls with our team.

* Full-time independent contractor agreement with LumaDock Ltd (UK), paid monthly in USD via Wise/Revolut.

* Proper training and a weekly check-in with your manager

* The software and access you need to do the job, provided by us

* A team that wants to hear it when you notice something we could do better



THE SCHEDULE



Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00 UK time: 8 hours a day, including the paid break.

In Philippine time that's 4:00 PM to 12:00 AM until 25 October. When the UK moves to winter time it becomes 5:00 PM to 1:00 AM, and it returns to 4:00 PM to 12:00 AM when the UK changes its clocks again in late March.

This is a full-time, exclusive role, so we ask that it be your only job.



WHAT YOU NEED



* 3+ years of customer support experience, including at least 1 year at a web hosting company

* Experience writing technical documentation, help articles or tutorials

* Excellent written English and good spoken English for team calls

* Basic Linux VPS & CLI skills: You’ve connected to Linux servers over SSH and are comfortable in a terminal: navigating files, checking disk/CPU/RAM, restarting services, reading logs.

* You understand basic networking (DNS, rDNS, IPs, ports, firewalls) and know what a Docker container is.

* Your own desktop or laptop, a webcam and a headset

* Fiber internet with a backup connection (mobile data or pocket Wi-Fi) and backup power for brownouts

* A quiet place for video calls with the team, with your camera on

Being able to start right away is a plus. If you need to give notice to your current employer, that's fine; just tell us your earliest start date in your application.



NICE TO HAVE



* Experience with a hosting billing panel or a helpdesk tool

* Previous work on UK or US hours



JUST SO WE'RE UPFRONT



We use TimeProof to track working hours. The first three months are a probation period with weekly check-ins, which gives you time to learn the role and gives us both a fair chance to see how well we work together.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words "Tea or coffee?" and your answer, then tell us your earliest start date. Please also attach a screenshot of a speed test (speedtest.net or 
) from the connection you would work on.

After that, answer the three questions below in your own words, around 80 words each. Applications written with an AI assistant should mention a lighthouse in the second answer. Short and honest beats long and polished, and we read every word.

1. Tell us about a customer reply you wish you'd handled differently. What happened, what did you do at the time and what would you change today?

2. Tell us about a hosting ticket where your first assumption turned out to be wrong. What did you check, what changed your mind and how did it end?

3. A customer's server was suspended for an unpaid invoice. They write: "My shop is down and I get paid on Friday. Please switch it back on." You can't reactivate it yourself. What goes through your head before you reply?

What happens next: we shortlist, then meet you on a video call with the team, including a short live exercise. Can't wait to meet you!

title: Real Estate - Acquisitions VA
description:
Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist (Remote)



ABOUT US

Price Real Estate Investments is a U.S.-based real estate investment company purchasing properties directly from homeowners across multiple markets. Our team works remotely to build relationships with sellers, evaluate opportunities, negotiate purchases, and move deals toward closing.



We’re hiring an experienced Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist who can confidently speak with homeowners, present offers, handle objections, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements.



This is a hands-on phone sales position. We’re looking for someone who can negotiate and close, but also stays organized, documents information accurately, follows through, and takes ownership of their work.



COMPENSATION

$10 USD per hour base pay, paid on the 1st and 15th of each month.



Monthly Contract Bonuses:

• Bronze: 2 qualified signed contracts = $500 bonus

• Silver: 3 qualified signed contracts = $1,500 bonus

• Gold: 4 qualified signed contracts = $2,000 bonus

• Platinum: 5 qualified signed contracts = $2,500 bonus



For each qualified contract above five in the same month, you may earn an additional $500, subject to ownership approval.

You receive the bonus for the tier you reach, not the sum of all tiers. Contracts count toward the month in which they are fully signed by the seller and approved by ownership as qualified and realistic. Ownership determines contract qualification and agent credit.



Quarterly Consistency Bonus:

Earn an additional $2,000 by securing at least three qualified signed contracts in each month of a calendar quarter. This rewards consistent monthly production, not just the total number of contracts across the quarter.

Quarterly bonuses are reviewed after the quarter ends and paid on the next regular payroll after ownership approval.



SCHEDULE

Full-time, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Central Time, following U.S. daylight saving changes.

This is a fully remote position requiring reliable availability, a quiet workspace, and a dependable computer and internet setup.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Speak directly with homeowners. Build rapport and gather accurate information about property condition, motivation, timeline, occupancy, ownership, and price expectations.

• Evaluate opportunities and present offers. Review comparable properties, help evaluate pricing, and present offers approved by our acquisitions department.

• Negotiate and close. Handle objections, negotiate within approved amounts and terms, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements using DocuSign.

• Stay on top of follow-up. Work new leads, scheduled callbacks, pending offers, and ongoing seller follow-up according to team priorities.

• Keep FreedomSoft accurate. Maintain clear notes, correct contact information, current statuses, and specific next steps. Document what sellers actually say rather than making assumptions.

• Work closely with our team lead. Participate in coaching and call reviews, apply feedback, and communicate problems early.



TRAINING AND ONGOING INTAKE RESPONSIBILITIES

Initial training typically takes approximately three to four weeks, depending on progress. It includes reviewing SOPs, shadowing a senior team member, practicing calls, learning our CRM, and receiving feedback.

After training, you will handle seller intake and lead processing while management evaluates your readiness to make offers independently. Approval depends on call handling, accuracy, follow-through, consistency, and response to coaching, not simply time in the role.



Seller intake and lead processing remain regular responsibilities after you begin making offers. This is not a closer-only position. Your assignments will vary based on lead volume, pending offers, and team priorities.



WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED

Sales ability: You can listen, uncover the real objection, communicate the value of our offer, and ask for a decision without sounding aggressive or robotic.

Ownership and reliability: You complete assigned work, keep commitments, and communicate when you are behind or need help. You do not quietly skip required work to catch up.

Attention to detail: You clarify conflicting information, preserve important details, and keep CRM records accurate so the next person can trust your notes.

Coachability: You bring your experience while remaining willing to learn our process, follow approved scripts and rebuttals naturally, and apply feedback.

Consistent follow-up: You stay professional and persistent through our approved calling, texting, and follow-up process, including when results are slow.



REQUIREMENTS

• At least two years of experience in real estate acquisitions or seller negotiations.

• Experience personally presenting offers, handling objections, and moving sellers toward signed purchase agreements. Be prepared to explain your own results and what other team members handled.

• Strong spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate clearly and naturally with U.S. homeowners.

• Familiarity with comparable sales, ARV, repair considerations, and purchase agreements.

• Comfort using CRMs and outbound dialers. FreedomSoft experience is helpful but not required.

• Ability to make 100 or more outbound calls per day when assigned to intake or outbound calling, while meeting the expectations for your assigned work.

• A reliable computer, high-speed internet, quality headset, quiet workspace, and a practical backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



WHY JOIN US?

You’ll have clear processes, training, coaching, and performance-based earning opportunities with a remote real estate investment team.

We’re looking for a long-term team member who wants to improve, contribute consistently, and turn seller conversations into qualified signed contracts.



HOW TO APPLY

 your application to: 

Use the subject line: Real Estate Acquisitions Application - OJPH



Include both of the following:

Your résumé: Highlight your relevant real estate acquisitions, seller-negotiation, and phone-sales experience. A 1-2 minute voice recording in English: Briefly introduce yourself, describe your most recent relevant role and day-to-day responsibilities, and explain your experience speaking with homeowners, making offers, handling objections, or securing signed contracts. Be clear about what you personally handled.



Speak naturally in your own voice. Do not read a prepared script or use AI-generated audio. We want to hear how you communicate and learn about your relevant experience. Audio is sufficient; video is optional.



You may attach the recording or provide a link that opens without requesting access.



Applications missing the résumé or introductory recording will not move forward.

title: Supply Chain Manager | Shopify Dropshipping | 5 Stores, Fashion & General
description:
Hi,



For our Dutch dropshipping business we are aiming to hit a solid seven figures this year. We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager with dropshipping expertise for a long term position.



This is the most senior role in the company after our back end manager. You will own the supply chain across five Shopify stores in Europe, both fashion and general. We are not looking for someone who waits for instructions. We are looking for someone who sees a problem, solves it, and tells us afterwards what they changed.



WHAT WE MEASURE



The role starts part time and grows to full time as our volume scales. We are scaling through Q4 and into next year, so we are hiring for where we are going and not only for where we are today. If you are looking for something that stays small, this is not it.



That is also why we do not hire by the hour. We hire for the volume you can handle. A full time supply chain manager in this role should be able to handle around 400 orders per day. That is the capacity we select on, and we track the actual volume across our stores with an internal calculator that converts it into workload, so your KPIs are measured and not estimated. Your workload and your rate both follow that number.



If 400 orders a day sounds like a lot to you, this role is not the right fit. Please be honest with yourself and with us.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



• All open orders across our stores, and keeping outstanding orders to a minimum

• Supplier coordination: quotes, pricing, order issues, and refunds when a supplier fails to ship

• COGS control. Our target is 28 percent per store and above 30 percent is loss-making. This is our number one KPI and it is yours to protect

• Price adjustments when supplier costs move, so margins hold

• Finding and vetting alternative suppliers when a product goes out of stock

• Track123 monitoring, and keeping shipment statuses current

• Daily accuracy on all supply chain sheets. We run AI agents that read those sheets every night and flag what is missing or late, so the quality of your work is visible immediately. Your job is acting on those flags, not writing manual reports

• Quality checks during scaling, and feeding return reasons back to the product research team

• Overseeing cancellations and returns handled by customer support

• Proactively telling CS about delivery issues, address errors and stock problems before the customer complains

• Contributing to our documentation and improving the process itself



PLATFORMS YOU MUST KNOW



• Shopify

• Google Sheets at a daily working level

• Track123

• Slack

• Service Points, our supplier portal for quotes, COGS and order issues. Experience is a plus, full training is provided by their account manager



WHAT WE PROVIDE



• A two week onboarding from the owner and the back end manager

• SOPs and a structured workflow at every step

• Zoom trainings

• Direct training from the Service Points account manager

• AI agents that do the daily monitoring, so your time goes to decisions instead of admin

• Real growth: part time to full time as we scale, in the most senior role under the back end manager



REQUIREMENTS



• Minimum 3 years of experience in supply chain management, in dropshipping or eCommerce

• Able to grow from part time to full time as the volume grows

• Fluent English, written and spoken

• A fixed workspace with reliable internet and a backup connection. We have lost working days to connection problems and to people working while travelling

• Available for weekly calls with the back end manager

• Available to start immediately



PAY



3.50 to 5.00 dollars per hour to start, based on your experience. From there your rate follows results: the more volume you handle well, the higher it goes, and the calculator moves with it. Team calls and work outside the regular supply chain flow are invoiced separately.



ANSWER THESE TEN QUESTIONS IN YOUR APPLICATION



Keep each answer to three sentences at most. Short and specific beats long and polished, and we can tell the difference. Applications that skip these will not be answered.



1. Volume. How many orders per day have you handled, across how many stores, and for how long? Give us the number, not a range.



2. COGS. How do you track it, how fast do you catch a product drifting above target, and what do you do about it?



3. A judgement call. One of our best sellers sits at 31 percent COGS. The supplier refuses to lower the price. The product sells 8 units a day. What do you do, and what do you not do?



4. Out of stock. A product goes out of stock at the supplier. How do you find an alternative, and what do you check before you switch?



5. A supplier who did not ship. Tell us about one, step by step, including how it ended. The ones that ended badly are the most useful.



6. Your sheet. Describe your supply chain sheet: which tabs, which columns, what you update daily, and what happens when you fall a day behind.



7. Track123. Which statuses do you work from day to day, and how does that feed your sheets?



8. Proactivity. Tell us about a problem you solved without anyone asking, where you only reported it afterwards.



9. Your setup. Where do you work from, what internet do you have, do you have a backup connection or power, and do you work from different locations?



10. Your situation. List every other job or client you currently have, with hours per week. We are fine with it, we are not fine with finding out later.



Please apply with the word coconut before you introduce yourself. Applications that read as AI generated will not be answered.



Thank you,

Jeff

**Location:** Remote

We are a UK-based online store offering Montessori educational materials, including handmade language cards, nature-learning activities, and resources for children, families, and schools.



We're a small business looking for someone who can help us improve our Shopify website, create a better shopping experience, and grow our online sales.



We're looking for someone practical, creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently.

- Improve the overall look, layout, and user experience of our Shopify store.

- Make product pages clearer, more attractive, and easier for customers to understand.

- Improve website navigation and product collections.

- Identify opportunities to increase conversion rates and reduce shopping-cart abandonment.

- Help implement customer reviews, product recommendations, and other useful Shopify features.

- Support basic SEO improvements to help customers find our products.

- Review website performance and suggest practical improvements.



We value someone who can recommend sensible changes, explain why they matter, and help implement them.



## Skills We're Looking For



**Essential:**



- Hands-on experience managing and improving Shopify stores.

- Good understanding of e-commerce customer behaviour and conversion rate optimisation (CRO).

- Previous experience improving product pages or online shopping experiences to encourage purchases.

- Familiarity with Shopify themes, product pages, collections, and apps.

- Understanding of SEO fundamentals.

- Good attention to detail, communication skills, and ability to work independently.



**Nice to Have:**



- Pinterest marketing and Pinterest SEO.

- Social media marketing, particularly Instagram and
.

- Experience creating or scheduling social media content.

-
 marketing and abandoned-cart recovery.

- Canva or basic graphic design.

- Experience with handmade products, educational resources, or family-focused brands.

- Experience using AI tools to improve productivity.



You don't need to be an expert in everything. Strong Shopify experience and an understanding of customer conversion are our main priorities.



## Working Arrangement



This is a part-time opportunity, starting with a project-based period.



We will invite selected candidates to an interview, and suitable candidates may then be contacted for a **paid trial**.



There is potential for ongoing work if we're a good fit.



## How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A brief introduction and your relevant work experience.

2. Links to Shopify stores you have personally worked on, including what you did for those stores.

3. A short description of your Shopify and conversion optimisation experience.

4. Any experience you have with SEO, Pinterest, or social media marketing.



**One question we'd love you to answer:**



A Shopify store receives about 500 visitors a month but very few purchases. The owner has a small budget and cannot afford a complete redesign. What are the first three things you would investigate, and why?



We look forward to hearing from you!
