title: Senior Vue 3 Developer — Technical SEO & Multilingual Website Cleanup
description:
Senior Vue 3 Developer — Technical SEO & Multilingual Website Cleanup



We are looking for an experienced freelance developer to review, fix and test the technical SEO setup of InfoAlanya, a multilingual tourism platform.



Duration: Flexible, potentially a few days to several weeks. The exact scope and duration will depend on the initial assessment and the work required.

Availability: Full-time during the agreed project period.

Location: Remote

Start: Immediately.



We need someone who can make this project their main work priority, with consistent availability and focused working time. Please apply only if your other commitments will not interfere with delivery or communication.



About the project



Our website offers tours, airport transfers, property listings, local services and travel guides in seven languages: English, Turkish, German, Russian, Danish, Norwegian Bokmål and Swedish.



We already have a frontend developer and a backend developer. Our frontend developer does not specialise in SEO, so we need someone who can independently identify technical issues, implement fixes and verify the results while collaborating with our team.



This is a hands-on technical cleanup project. We need someone who can both diagnose and fix issues.



Our team is currently developing an article publishing feature in our admin panel, expected to be ready within the next few days. We will create and manage articles through admin. Your role is to help ensure the technical SEO and publishing flow work correctly, alongside fixing issues across the existing website.



What we need you to do



Review the existing code and public website, identify technical SEO issues and prioritise fixes.



Fix inconsistent language URLs and ensure the URL determines the displayed language, including for visitors who are not logged in.



Ensure navigation, language switching and shared links use the correct language URLs.



Review and implement translated slugs where needed, coordinating with our backend developer.



Preserve existing links with appropriate permanent redirects when URLs change.



Check and fix page titles, meta descriptions, canonical tags, hreflang, Open Graph tags and relevant structured data.



Check robots directives, HTTP status codes and sitemap coverage so public pages can be crawled and indexed correctly.



Review our build-time prerendering and sitemap generation.



Verify that articles created or updated through the upcoming admin feature appear correctly in the public HTML, with the correct language URLs and metadata, and are reflected in the sitemap.



Ensure drafts and unpublished language versions are not publicly exposed or included in the sitemap.



Identify significant performance and Core Web Vitals issues and address them within the agreed scope.



Test representative pages across all seven languages, including direct links, page refreshes and logged-out access.



Add relevant Vitest tests and update Playwright smoke tests where your changes affect existing flows.



Verify that changes do not break the other portals or existing translations.



Document the changes and provide a concise handover, including any remaining issues.



Our stack



Vue 3, Composition API and 



Vite and Vuetify



Vue Router, Pinia and vue-i18n



JavaScript and Axios



Node.js build scripts and build-time prerendering



NestJS backend API



GitHub, Vitest and Playwright



Docker and Nginx



One application serves the public website plus admin, vendor, affiliate and driver portals. Changes must follow the existing conventions and be scoped and tested carefully.



Required experience



Senior-level experience building and maintaining production Vue 3 applications.



Proven technical SEO implementation experience on JavaScript websites.



Multilingual routing, translated slugs, hreflang and canonical URLs.



Prerendering or server-side rendering.



URL migrations and redirects.



Metadata, Open Graph tags and structured data.



Performance analysis and Core Web Vitals.



Google Search Console, PageSpeed Insights/Lighthouse and a crawler such as Screaming Frog.



Git and experience working safely in a shared codebase.



Ability to work independently and collaborate with our existing developers.



Clear communication in English.



Full-time availability and the ability to prioritise this project during the agreed engagement.



Relevant, demonstrable experience matters more than the “senior” title alone.



Optional: UI/UX and design skills



UI/UX or web design skills are a welcome bonus, but are not required for this project. If you also have strong design skills, there may be opportunities to help with website design and user experience in a separate future project.



Expected outcome



A tested, consistent technical SEO setup across the agreed public page types, with the highest-priority issues fixed and a verified publishing flow from admin to the public website.



We will start with a short assessment, then agree on priorities, estimated hours and scope before proceeding with implementation. This will be followed by verification and a concise handover to our team.



To apply



Please include:



A relevant Vue project where you implemented or fixed technical SEO, explaining your own contribution.



Your experience with multilingual URLs and prerendering.



How you would approach the initial assessment.



Your earliest start date. We are looking for someone who can start immediately.



Confirmation that you can work full-time and make this project your main priority during the engagement.



Your hourly rate. We are a startup with a limited budget, so a competitive rate would be appreciated. There may be opportunities for further collaboration as we grow, although this initial engagement is for the project described above.



Any UI/UX or web design examples, if applicable. These are optional.



A preliminary estimate of the working days and total hours you expect to need based on the scope above. Explain your assumptions and what you would need to review before confirming the estimate. We understand that the final estimate will depend on the initial code review.



Please apply only if you can implement the technical fixes yourself. We are not looking for backlink services, content packages or an audit-only service.

title: WordPress Content Specialist
description:
WordPress Content Specialist

St. Louis, Missouri • Remote (Philippines-based)



About Lelander

Lelander is a St. Louis–based software and tech consultancy that partners with agencies and organizations to build custom digital solutions, from mobile apps to complex web platforms. Our work is collaborative, thoughtful, and shaped by a flexible mindset. We value people who enjoy working independently but want to be part of a respectful, communicative team.



About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized and technically proficient WordPress Content Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for loading, formatting, and publishing content across a diverse portfolio of WordPress websites, as well as collaborating closely with our SEO team to ensure our sites remain healthy and optimized.



Because our websites vary greatly—ranging from fully custom builds with different base themes to purchased or inherited themes—we need someone who is highly adaptable and comfortable navigating different WordPress environments.



Please note: This is not a web developer role (you won't be writing PHP or building custom plugins). However, a deep, fundamental understanding of how WordPress works under the hood, how different themes behave, and how to troubleshoot basic formatting or structural issues is critical for success.



Key Responsibilities

• Content Loading & Formatting: Input, format, and publish text, images, videos, and other media across a wide variety of WordPress sites.

• SEO Implementation: Work hand-in-hand with the SEO team to execute on-page updates, fix structural issues, and apply optimizations based on routine site audits.

• Redirect Management: Safely configure, map, and test 301 redirects (using plugins like Redirection, Yoast, etc.) during content updates or site restructures to preserve link equity and prevent 404 errors.

• Theme Navigation: Confidently navigate and utilize various WordPress setups, including custom themes, premium/purchased themes, inherited legacy themes, and popular page builders (e.g., Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, WPBakery).

• Quality Assurance: Review all loaded content on the front-end across multiple devices to ensure formatting is clean, responsive, and aligns with the site's design guidelines.

• Media Management: Upload and manage media assets, ensuring images are properly sized, compressed, and tagged with appropriate alt text.

• Light Troubleshooting: Use basic HTML/CSS knowledge to fix minor formatting quirks or layout issues that often arise within WYSIWYG editors or page builders.

• Process Management: Keep track of content status, manage drafts, and coordinate cross-functionally with designers, project managers, and the SEO team to ensure deadlines are met.



Requirements & Qualifications

• Proven WordPress Expertise: Extensive hands-on experience using WordPress as a CMS. You should know the dashboard like the back of your hand (Posts, Pages, Custom Post Types, Menus, Widgets, Media Library).

• Technical Aptitude: While you do not need to be a developer, you must have a strong technical understanding of how WordPress themes, plugins, and page builders interact.

• SEO & Redirect Competency: Practical experience executing basic on-page SEO tasks and a solid understanding of how to safely implement URL redirects.

• Basic Code Literacy: Working knowledge of basic HTML and CSS to resolve minor formatting issues without needing to escalate to a developer.

• Adaptability: Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new, unfamiliar, or poorly documented WordPress environments and inherited themes.

• Extreme Attention to Detail: A sharp eye for design consistency, typography, and spacing to ensure the final published pages look polished.

• Time Management: Ability to juggle multiple sites, content pipelines, and SEO punch-lists simultaneously.



Nice-to-Haves (Optional)

• Familiarity with basic image editing tools (Photoshop, Canva, Figma) for quick cropping or resizing.

• Experience with specific SEO tools like Google Search Console (to better speak the SEO team's language).



How We Work

Lelander operates as a remote-first studio with team members and collaborators across the globe.

As a freelance WordPress Content Specialist, you'll work under an hourly contract with flexible scheduling, though availability during CST business hours is required to support client requests and team collaboration.

Typical workloads may vary based on project and retainer needs.

While this role does not include benefits, we do offer autonomy, flexibility, and the opportunity to work with a collaborative and thoughtful team.

title: Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Amazon PPC Specialist to manage and optimize advertising campaigns across multiple Amazon accounts.



This is a client-facing role, so the ideal candidate should be comfortable presenting performance updates, explaining strategy, answering client questions, and communicating recommendations clearly.



You will be responsible for day-to-day campaign management, performance analysis, keyword and targeting expansion, and identifying opportunities to improve sales and advertising efficiency. You will work closely with the Amazon Advertising Lead to execute account strategies and ensure campaigns are consistently optimized toward client goals.



Key Responsibilities

* Manage and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display.

* Perform regular campaign audits and identify opportunities for optimization and expansion.

* Conduct keyword, search term, competitor, and ASIN targeting research.

* Build and manage brand, non-brand, product targeting, category targeting, and defensive campaigns.

* Monitor and optimize bids, budgets, placements, keywords, and product targets.

* Analyze performance across campaign, keyword, search term, and ASIN levels.

* Track key metrics including Spend, Sales, ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, CTR, CPC, CVR, and Orders.

* Identify high-performing search terms and opportunities for campaign expansion.

* Identify inefficient campaigns and targets and take appropriate optimization actions.

* Monitor budget utilization and ensure spend is aligned with account goals.

* Identify PPC opportunities that can support organic ranking and overall sales growth.

* Consider inventory, pricing, conversion rate, and other factors when analyzing advertising performance.

* Prepare and support weekly and monthly performance reporting.

* Join client calls and present campaign performance, insights, and next steps.

* Explain advertising strategy and performance in a clear and concise way.

* Respond to client questions and provide data-backed recommendations.

* Use AI tools and PPC management software to support analysis, reporting, campaign, optimization, research, and workflow efficiency.

* Clearly document optimizations, findings, tests, and recommended next steps.

* Stay current with Amazon Ads updates and advertising best practices.



Requirements

* At least 5+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience.

* Strong experience managing Amazon advertising accounts.

* Strong understanding of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display.

* Strong understanding of keyword targeting, product targeting, match types, search term harvesting, negatives, placements, bids, and budget management.

* Comfortable analyzing advertising data using Excel or Google Sheets.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to diagnose changes in sales and advertising performance and determine potential causes.

* Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities independently.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

* Comfortable speaking directly with clients and presenting performance updates and recommendations.

* Ability to communicate complex advertising topics in a simple, business-focused way.

* Comfortable using AI tools, automation, and PPC management software as part of day-to-day campaign management.

* Willingness to learn and adapt to new tools, platforms, and workflows.



Preferred Experience

* Strong Amazon PPC experience

* Amazon DSP experience is a plus



Performance KPIs

Performance will be evaluated across account results, execution quality, client management, and strategic contribution.

1. Account Performance

* Maintain PPC performance within the agreed client targets for ACoS, ROAS, TACoS, sales growth or profitability.

* Identify declining performance early and take corrective action.

* Improve efficiency or scale spend where opportunities exist.

* Maintain appropriate budget pacing throughout the month.

* Reduce unnecessary spend and continuously identify opportunities to improve campaign performance.



Target: Managed accounts meeting or progressing toward their agreed advertising objectives each month.



2. Optimization & Execution

* Complete scheduled account optimizations consistently and on time.

* Maintain clean campaign structures and accurate naming conventions.

* Regularly review search terms, keywords, ASIN targets, bids, placements, negatives, and budgets.

* Launch approved campaigns and tests within agreed timelines.

* Ensure campaign changes are properly documented.



Target: Planned optimizations and campaign tasks completed by deadline, with minimal execution errors.



3. Proactive Growth & Testing

* Identify new keyword, product targeting, category targeting, and campaign opportunities.

* Recommend and execute structured tests based on account performance.

* Surface opportunities to scale successful campaigns or products.

* Use PPC data to support broader recommendations around conversion, ranking, inventory, pricing, or listing performance.



Target: At least 2 meaningful growth or optimization recommendations per account per month, where applicable.



4. Client Communication

* Come prepared to client meetings with clear performance insights and recommended next steps.

* Communicate account changes and issues proactively.

* Respond to client questions accurately and professionally.

* Explain advertising performance in a way that is easy for clients to understand.



Target: Client deliverables completed on time, with no recurring communication or preparedness issues.



5. Reporting & Analysis

* Deliver accurate weekly and monthly reporting.

* Go beyond reporting metrics by explaining what changed, why it changed, and what should happen next.

* Ensure reporting data is accurate and aligned with Amazon Ads and account performance.



Target: 100% of reports delivered by deadline with accurate data



6. AI & Tool Adoption

* Effectively use approved AI tools, automation, and PPC management software to improve efficiency.

* Look for opportunities to automate repetitive work without compromising accuracy.

* Adopt new tools and workflows introduced by the team.



Target: Consistent use of approved tools and demonstrated improvement in workflow efficiency.



What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can think beyond simply adjusting bids.



You should be able to look at an account and determine:

* Where there are opportunities to grow sales.

* Which keywords or targets should be expanded.

* Where advertising budget is being wasted.

* Which products should receive more advertising support.

* Why sales, conversion, or advertising performance changed.

* Whether performance issues are related to PPC, inventory, pricing, conversion, or other factors.

* What actions should be taken next.

* Where AI, automation, or PPC management tools can help improve efficiency and decision-making.



You should be comfortable managing campaigns independently, making data-backed recommendations, and confidently discussing those recommendations directly with clients.



Success in This Role

Success means consistently delivering against client advertising objectives, maintaining strong execution standards, proactively identifying growth opportunities, communicating clearly with clients, and managing accounts with minimal supervision.

title: Technical Business Analyst & Product QA Lead – SaaS / CRM
description:
Technical Business Analyst & Product QA Lead – SaaS / CRM



Remote | Philippines | Full-time preferred



We are looking for an experienced Technical Business Analyst and Product QA Lead to help complete and improve an existing business management software platform.



The platform supports workflows such as customer management, quoting, job management, scheduling, invoicing, inventory and accounting integrations.



You will work directly with the product owner and lead developer to understand how the system should work, identify gaps, document clear business rules and thoroughly test completed changes.



We need someone who can take a discussion, recording or rough explanation and turn it into clear requirements that developers can implement and testers can verify. You should be comfortable asking questions, identifying missing scenarios and following issues through to resolution.



Your responsibilities will include:



Review the existing application and understand its workflows, users and business processes.



Work with the product owner to define intended behaviour and resolve unclear or conflicting requirements.



Map workflows and document business rules, user stories and acceptance criteria.



Identify missing steps, confusing interfaces, inconsistent behaviour and opportunities to simplify workflows.



Create clear GitHub issues containing the problem, reproduction steps, expected and actual results, supporting screenshots or recordings, and acceptance criteria.



Distinguish bugs from new feature requests and decisions that need product-owner approval.



Perform hands-on testing across complete workflows, including normal use, unusual scenarios, errors and permissions.



Verify fixes and perform regression testing to check that existing functionality still works.



Help maintain an organised backlog, prioritise launch blockers and communicate progress clearly.



Keep workflow documentation and test cases aligned with approved changes.



Coordinate with developers and testers so that work is only marked complete once the agreed requirements have been verified.



Accounting and integration experience would be particularly valuable. Where applicable, you will help check that information moving between our platform and Xero is accurate and consistent, including customers, invoices, taxes, payments and transaction statuses.



We are looking for someone with:



Proven experience in software business analysis, product analysis, hands-on QA or a closely related role.



Experience working with an existing SaaS, CRM, ERP or business management platform.



Strong ability to turn business requirements into practical workflows and testable acceptance criteria.



Experience investigating issues and writing clear, actionable reports for developers.



Strong understanding of end-to-end testing, edge cases and regression testing.



Familiarity with GitHub Issues, Jira or a similar issue-management system.



Clear written and spoken English.



Strong attention to detail, logical thinking and the ability to work independently.



Confidence raising concerns when requirements are unclear or completed work does not meet the agreed behaviour.



Useful additional experience includes:



Xero usage, implementation or integration testing.



Trade services, field service, construction, job management or inventory software.



Invoicing, purchasing, bookkeeping and tax-related workflows.



API testing with Postman, reading JSON, browser developer tools or basic SQL.



Playwright or other automated testing tools.



Figma, wireframes or workflow diagrams.



A development background that helps you investigate issues and collaborate with engineers.



Programming is not the main responsibility of this role. Initial work will use the test application, documentation and issue tracker; access to the application’s source code is not required.



This is a hands-on role. We need someone who will actively use the system, understand the business logic, find problems, propose practical improvements and verify the results.



Pay is negotiable based on experience. Please include your expected hourly rate and currency.



Please also provide your weekly availability, preferred working hours, timezone and earliest start date. Agreed daily overlap with the product owner and development team will be required.



Time-tracking software will be used during the initial engagement.



To apply, please submit:



Your CV and a short summary of your relevant business analysis and QA experience.



Details of any CRM, SaaS, trade services or business management platforms you have worked on, explaining your responsibilities.



Your experience with Xero or other accounting integrations.



An anonymised example of a workflow, business requirement or user story with acceptance criteria.



An example of a clear bug report you have written, including how you verified the fix.



Your expected hourly rate and currency, availability and earliest start date.



Please also briefly describe a time you identified a workflow or business-rule problem that others had missed, and how you helped resolve it.



Please use “Technical BA & Product QA Lead” as your application subject.

title: Social Media, Content Strategy & Meta Ads Manager
description:
Burwood Wellness Chiropractic is looking for an organised, strategic, creative and commercially minded Social Media, Content Strategy & Meta Ads Manager. You will own the end-to-end strategy that connects organic social content, content production briefs and Meta advertising to generate qualified local enquiries and booked-in patients.



The practice serves patients in Burwood and Turramurra and presents a family-oriented chiropractic approach for musculoskeletal concerns, including back, neck, joint and muscle discomfort. The practice’s public positioning emphasises a structured care approach and a personal patient experience.  



This is not a generic posting role. You will be accountable for the full content-to-conversion system: defining the strategy, creating the content plan and briefs, converting approved content into organic posts and ads, launching campaigns, testing, optimising, reporting and improving. You will work within a health-advertising environment where every clinical claim, offer and patient-facing creative must pass the practice’s approval process before publication.



What success looks like



Within the first 90 days, the successful person will have:



•Developed an evidence-informed content strategy that links priority patient audiences, approved service messages, organic content pillars and Meta campaign themes to qualified enquiries and bookings.



•Built a dependable monthly content engine that the clinic can implement through clear calendars, briefs, capture plans, asset requirements and approval deadlines.



•Brought all Meta activity into a clear campaign structure, with advertising creative drawn from the approved content strategy, reliable tracking, lead handling and weekly reporting.



•Established a documented compliance and approval workflow so no paid or organic clinical content publishes without sign-off from the nominated clinical approver.



•Delivered a repeatable test-and-learn programme for creative, audiences, offers and landing-page/lead-form paths.



•Improved the quality, speed of follow-up and visibility of qualified enquiries, rather than optimising only for low-cost leads.



How this role works



The manager owns the strategy and the marketing execution. This includes determining the content pillars, campaign priorities, audience messages, content calendar, creative briefs, organic posting plan, Meta ad concepts, campaign setup and ongoing optimisation.



The clinic implements the on-the-ground inputs required by the strategy. This includes making clinicians or team members available for agreed content capture, providing accurate approved information, filming or supplying requested footage when needed, reviewing content promptly, approving clinical claims and offers, and following up leads quickly. The manager turns those approved materials into posts and ads and will make practical recommendations when an asset, landing page or follow-up process is preventing results.



The intended outcome is not simply more content or cheaper leads. It is a coordinated system that attracts suitable local prospects, creates confidence before they enquire and helps the clinic convert qualified enquiries into booked-in patients.



Core responsibilities



1. Own the content strategy and clinic implementation plan



•Develop a quarterly and rolling 90-day content strategy aligned to practice goals, patient demand, seasonality, service priorities, approved claims and available clinic capacity.



•Define priority patient audiences, their likely questions and objections, content pillars, key messages, calls to action, channel roles and the journey from content view to enquiry to booking.



•Translate the strategy into a practical monthly content calendar that specifies each asset, channel, purpose, format, hook, call to action, required approval and owner.



•Create simple, reusable content briefs and shot lists so the clinic team knows exactly what to capture, who needs to participate, what to say or show, and when the material is due.



•Plan how high-performing organic themes and approved clinic assets will be repurposed into Meta ad creative, without treating organic and paid activity as separate silos.



•Review strategy performance monthly and adjust content priorities based on lead quality, booking outcomes, campaign data, practice feedback and changing local demand.



2. Manage social media and turn the strategy into content



•Create platform-native content including short-form video briefs and edits, Reels, Stories, carousels, static posts, captions and calls to action.



•Convert approved practitioner input into simple, empathetic, easy-to-understand patient education. Use plain language and avoid unapproved clinical claims.



•Coordinate efficient content capture with the practice team, including shot lists, filming days, content requests and asset storage.



•Publish approved content, manage scheduling, basic community management and escalation of enquiries to the practice team.



•Track content performance and use insights to improve themes, hooks, formats, posting cadence and calls to action.



3. Plan and manage Meta Ads



•Build, launch and 
 Meta campaigns across
 and Instagram for agreed business goals, such as qualified enquiries, booking requests, new-patient offers or remarketing.



•Structure campaigns, audiences, placements, creative testing and budgets cleanly in Meta Ads Manager.



•Implement and quality-check tracking, including the Meta Pixel, Conversions API where available, event definitions, lead-form fields, UTMs and dashboard inputs. Work with the practice’s web or CRM support when technical changes are needed.



•Create compliant ad copy, creative briefs and landing-page recommendations that match the prospect’s intent and campaign promise.



•Monitor delivery, spend, frequency, creative fatigue, lead quality and conversion outcomes. Make documented optimisation decisions rather than changing campaigns reactively.



•Maintain a testing backlog covering angles, formats, audiences, offers, lead forms and follow-up paths.



•Protect budget by flagging tracking issues, low-quality lead patterns, poor follow-up, compliance concerns or landing-page friction promptly.



4. Keep healthcare advertising compliant



•Use a mandatory pre-publication checklist for every organic post, paid ad, lead form, landing-page copy and promotion.



•Route any clinical claim, practitioner credential, patient-related content, treatment outcome, offer or condition-specific message to the nominated clinical approver before publication.



•Never publish patient testimonials or patient stories that refer to symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, outcomes or practitioner clinical skill. Such content may constitute prohibited testimonials when used to advertise a regulated health service. 



•Do not use unsupported, absolute or outcome-guarantee claims; claims about treating non-musculoskeletal conditions; language that implies a treatment is risk-free; or language that encourages unnecessary treatment. 



•Ensure that any discount, gift or promotional offer has clear, accessible terms and conditions approved by the practice before launch. 



•Keep a dated approval record and a simple creative/claim register for all campaigns.



5. Report, collaborate and improve



•Deliver a concise weekly performance update and a deeper monthly marketing report with insights, actions, tests and decisions required.



•Reconcile Meta platform metrics with the practice’s lead, booking and attendance data wherever available.



•Work closely with reception or the patient-conversion owner to understand lead outcomes and improve speed-to-lead, scripts, reminders and booking conversion.



•Maintain clear files, naming conventions, access documentation and campaign-change logs.



•Bring proactive ideas, while respecting that clinical accuracy and compliance take priority over speed to publish.



Required experience and capabilities



Essential



•3+ years managing social media and Meta Ads for a service business, healthcare/wellness brand or performance-focused agency.



•Proven ability to develop a content strategy and turn it into an implementable calendar, creative brief system, organic social plan and paid-Meta campaign plan.



•Proven ability to manage campaigns from strategy through creative, launch, optimisation and performance reporting.



•Strong hands-on Meta Ads Manager capability, including campaign setup, budget management, audience strategy, lead generation, retargeting, creative testing and reporting.



•Excellent English copywriting and editing. You can explain useful information clearly without hype, clichés or overclaiming.



•Strong short-form content skills, including Canva plus a video-editing workflow such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar.



•Confident analytical ability with Meta Ads reporting, spreadsheets and core marketing metrics.



•Experience using project-management, social scheduling and shared-asset tools.



•A reliable remote-work setup, consistent internet connection, disciplined time management and availability for the agreed Australian-time collaboration window.



•A portfolio or case studies that demonstrate content-strategy judgement, creative work and measurable paid-social outcomes.



Strongly preferred



•Experience marketing an Australian healthcare, allied-health, medical, dental or regulated professional service.



•Practical understanding of Ahpra advertising expectations, or a demonstrated ability to learn and apply a regulated content-approval process quickly.



•Experience integrating Meta lead generation with a CRM, appointment platform, website form or call-tracking process.



•Experience with local-area service marketing and community-oriented social content.



•Experience briefing or coordinating creators, photographers, videographers or front-desk staff for content capture.



What we value



•Sound judgement: you know when a claim needs approval and do not guess.



•Commercial ownership: you care about qualified appointments and revenue contribution, not vanity metrics.



•Craft: your content feels trustworthy, polished and human.



•Curiosity: you test hypotheses and learn from results.



•Calm organisation: you can manage a content calendar, live campaigns and stakeholder input without dropped details.



•Clear communication: you summarise performance, risk and next actions in a way busy practice leaders can use.

4  Remote monitoring and routine maintenance

5  Ticket documentation and knowledge management

•  Document symptoms, diagnostic steps, tests, results, user communications and resolution details clearly.

•  Follow runbooks and documented client configurations; improve knowledge articles and flag gaps in standard procedures.

•  Identify recurring i
 and participate in ticket-quality reviews and technical coaching.



6  Escalation, collaboration and service quality

•  Work with the Technical Support Manager and designated senior engineers on unresolved, complex or high-risk i
.

•  Provide concise escalations covering the problem, affected users, impact, evidence, checks performed and required next action.

•  Apply agreed ticket priorities, response and communication standards, service entitlements and support boundaries.

•  Record time against the correct customer, package and work category; notify the manager if a request is outside entitlement.

•  Help improve first-contact resolution, ticket consistency, user communication and overall service quality.



Essential experience and capabilities

Practical IT support

•  At least one year of practical service-desk or remote end-user support experience; approximately one to three years is particularly relevant.

•  Hands-on troubleshooting of Windows computers, Microsoft 365 and Outlook.

•  Ability to diagnose common printer, workstation, application and user-access issues.

•  Basic working knowledge of DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPNs and account-access principles.

•  A methodical approach to diagnosis, willingness to use a runbook and sound judgement about when to stop and escalate.



Customer service and security

•  Clear spoken and written English suitable for direct communication with business users.

•  Patient, courteous and professional communication with non-technical or frustrated customers.

•  Accurate written ticket notes and good organisation across multiple assigned requests.

•  Consistent application of identity checks, confidentiality, least privilege and secure remote-support procedures.

•  Ability to recognise i
 outside personal authority or capability and escalate promptly.



Remote working

•  Based in the Philippines and able to provide the agreed full-time support coverage.

•  Reliable internet and power, with practical backup arrangements.

•  A quiet, secure and professional work environment suitable for customer calls and remote support.

•  Ability to use approved equipment and security-controlled customer systems.



Preferred experience — not essential

•  Experience working in an MSP, outsourced IT service provider or multi-client support team.

•  Exposure to ticketing and service-management platforms, remote monitoring and management (RMM), or structured i
 workflows.

•  Familiarity with Zoho Desk, Zoho Assist, Datto RMM, Microsoft Intune or Entra ID.

•  Basic exposure to business telephony/VoIP, endpoint security, backups or monitoring alerts.

•  Experience supporting UK or Australian business users, schools, charities or environments with additional data-protection requirements.

•  Microsoft Fundamentals, CompTIA A+ or comparable technical training; equivalent hands-on capability is welcomed.



What success looks like

•  Support requests are correctly logged, prioritised and responded to in accordance with procedures.

•  Identity and authorisation checks are consistently completed before account or access changes.

•  Routine documented issues are resolved independently when safe and authorised.

•  Ticket notes, time records, customer updates and escalations are accurate and useful.

•  Security concerns and work outside the support entitlement are identified and escalated without delay.

•  Knowledge articles and recurring-issue feedback contribute to continuous service improvement.

During onboarding, you will learn the relevant customer environments, support tools and escalation processes. The range of tasks you may perform independently will expand with demonstrated competence and appropriate authorisation.



Working arrangements and contractor engagement

This is an ongoing, full-time remote contractor engagement based in the Philippines. Expected capacity is approximately 40 hours per week. The exact schedule, coverage, commencement date and service expectations will be agreed in writing before the engagement begins.

The initial technical-support requirement is UK-facing. Agreed coverage may fall in the Philippine late afternoon, evening or later hours and must account for seasonal changes in UK time. Weekend work, on-call duties and additional out-of-hours coverage are not included automatically and require separate agreement.



Single-fee invoicing arrangement

The contractor will issue one monthly invoice for the agreed services. The all-inclusive gross fee must cover normal contractor costs and personal provisions, including applicable tax, statutory contributions, healthcare, time-off provision, equipment, internet, power, backups, and administration. No separate ordinary contractor allowances or benefits are assumed unless required by applicable law or expressly agreed in writing.

The written agreement will confirm the invoicing basis, treatment of authorised absence, partial months and additional hours, confidentiality, access and other operating arrangements. Approved business-system access and client-specific platforms will be arranged during onboarding; any non-standard equipment or expenditure requires prior agreement.



How to apply

Please provide a current CV, a brief summary of your Windows and Microsoft 365 troubleshooting experience, two anonymised examples of user-support issues you have resolved, the tools you have used, your availability for UK-aligned hours and your earliest possible start date.

Remove customer names, credentials and other confidential information from work examples. We value reliable service, clear customer communication, safe technical judgement and a willingness to learn.

Sketchpad has an established audience, but there’s plenty of work to do on the business side. Your job would be to help us understand what people need, find offers we can deliver well and build steady, profitable revenue.



Customers can buy a paid version of Sketchpad for drawing and design work. We’ll look at ways to grow those sales and explore suitable opportunities with schools and businesses. .

We are a fast-growing Dutch family business selling premium consumer products direct-to-consumer across the Netherlands and Belgium. Our brand combines lifestyle, luxury, and everyday use. We sell through our own webshop and run paid Meta ads as our primary growth channel.



We produce a high volume of video ads every month. Our creative strategy depends on speed, quality, and variety. That is why we are hiring a senior AI video editor who can work independently, deliver consistently, and grow with us long-term.



We pay above market rate. We pay on time, every time. Exact rate is discussed with shortlisted candidates.



The Role

You will report directly to the founder. You will receive structured briefs with clear deliverables, deadlines, and references. You are expected to deliver finished, upload-ready video ads without constant supervision.



What You’ll Create



You will produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video ads for Meta 
 & Instagram). This includes but is not limited to:



AI avatar videos – Talking head ads, founder-style videos, spokesperson formats. Realistic AI-generated presenters delivering a script to camera.

AI UGC creatives – Creator-style content that looks and feels like real user-generated content, but is fully or partially AI-generated.

AI dramatic and cartoon creatives – Storytelling ads, product dramatizations, animated explainer-style content, exaggerated visual scenarios to grab attention in the feed.

Hook variations – Multiple opening hooks on the same ad body, tested for performance.

Iterations on winning ads – Take a proven ad and create new versions with different visuals, pacing, or hooks.

Compilations – Combine raw footage, AI-generated clips, b-roll, voiceover, captions, and music into finished ads.



All content is delivered in 9:16 (Stories/Reels) and 1:1 (Feed) formats, export-ready for Meta upload.



What We Expect



You have a proven track record producing AI video creatives for paid social ads. Not personal projects, not YouTube content. Ads that ran on Meta or TikTok.

You understand ad pacing, visual hooks, and scroll-stopping techniques. You know the difference between content and a converting ad.

You can take a written brief, interpret it correctly, ask the right questions if something is unclear, and deliver a finished video without hand-holding.

You apply feedback fast. First revision within 24–48 hours. You don’t argue with feedback, you improve.

You are reliable. You deliver on time. If something blocks you, you communicate before the deadline, not after.

You are fluent in English. All communication, briefs, and scripts are in English.

You have your own hardware and software. We do not provide equipment.



Tools



You are expected to work with AI video generation tools. We want to know exactly which tools you use and how experienced you are with each. Examples include but are not limited to:



AI generation: HeyGen, Synthesia, Runway, Pika, Kling, Higgsfield, Arcads, Creatify

AI voice & audio: ElevenLabs, Murf, PlayHT

Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut

Other tools you use in your workflow



If you only know basic editing software and have no experience with AI generation tools, this role is not for you.



What We Offer



Above local market rate. We value quality and pay accordingly.

Reliable, on-time payments. Every time.

Structured briefs with clear expectations. No guessing what we want.

Direct access to the founder. Short feedback loops.

A long-term position with growing volume as we scale.

Room to grow into a senior creative role as the team expands.



Hiring Process



You reply to this post with your portfolio (links to AI video ads you created).

You fill out our application form via the link below. This is required.

Shortlisted candidates receive a paid trial. All trial candidates get the same brief, same deadline, same success criteria.

title: Client Service & Outbound Sales Coordinator – U.S. Insurance Agency (Part-Time, 25 Hours/Week)
description:
**Company:** Station 5 Insurance  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Schedule:** 20 hours per week, Monday–Friday, during U.S. Central Time business hours  

**Compensation:** $6 USD per hour, depending on experience, communication skills, and qualifications  

**Opportunity:** Long-term position with potential for growth



 About Us



Station 5 Insurance is an established independent insurance agency serving customers in Alabama and Texas. We have been in business for over 22 years and take pride in providing personalized, relationship-focused service.



We are looking for a friendly, confident, highly organized professional to join our team.



This is a hybrid **customer service and outbound calling position**. We need someone who genuinely enjoys speaking with people, can handle customer concerns with warmth and patience, and is comfortable making proactive calls to prospective and existing customers.



We are not looking for someone who simply answers calls and takes messages. We want someone who takes ownership, follows through, and helps us build stronger customer relationships.



 Your Responsibilities



**Inbound Customer Service (Approximately 60%)**



- Answer incoming customer calls professionally and warmly.

- Listen carefully to customer concerns and determine how best to assist.

- Help customers with routine insurance service inquiries and coordinate requests with our service team.

- Handle billing questions, policy document requests, claims intake, and other general inquiries within established procedures.

- Follow up with customers to ensure their requests are being addressed.

- Maintain accurate notes and track outstanding callbacks.

- Help direct customers to our agency's text-based service system when appropriate.

- Escalate questions requiring a licensed insurance agent.



**Outbound Calling & Business Development (Approximately 40%)**



- Contact former customers to explore opportunities to earn their business back.

- Call prospective customers from lead lists.

- Follow up with customers approaching their insurance renewal dates.

- Conduct follow-up calls on outstanding quotes and sales opportunities.

- Identify potential cross-selling opportunities with existing customers.

- Gather basic prospect information and schedule qualified opportunities for our licensed agents.

- Maintain organized records of calls, conversations, and follow-up dates.



You will not be expected to provide licensed insurance advice, recommend coverage, or bind insurance policies.



Who We're Looking For



Our ideal candidate is:



- **Warm and personable:** You sound friendly, approachable, and genuinely interested in helping people.

- **Excellent on the telephone:** You speak clear, fluent, conversational English and can comfortably communicate with American customers.

- **Confident but not pushy:** You enjoy outbound calling and know how to start conversations without sounding like a scripted telemarketer.

- **Empathetic and patient:** You can calmly assist customers who may be frustrated or concerned about their insurance.

- **Proactive:** You recognize what needs to be done and take initiative rather than waiting for constant instructions.

- **Highly organized:** You follow through on commitments and maintain accurate records.

- **Dependable:** You show up consistently, communicate well, and take responsibility for your work.

- **Comfortable with technology:** You can learn insurance software, customer management systems, phone applications, and Google Workspace.



 Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is especially valuable:



- U.S. insurance agencies

- Insurance customer service or appointment setting

- Outbound calling, lead generation, or sales follow-up

- U.S.-based customer support

- CRM software and Google Workspace



Insurance experience is preferred but not required. We are willing to train the right person.



Equipment Requirements



- Reliable high-speed internet

- Quiet, professional workspace

- Quality noise-canceling headset

- Computer capable of running cloud-based business applications

- Reliable backup plan for internet or power interruptions



What We Offer



- Long-term opportunity with an established U.S. business

- Consistent part-time schedule

- Training and clear procedures

- Supportive team environment

- Opportunity to expand responsibilities as the business grows

- A position where your customer service and communication skills truly matter



 How to Apply



**Please follow these instructions carefully. Applications missing the requested information may not be considered.**



**1.** Begin your application with the words **"Station 5 Customer Experience"**.



**2.** Tell us about your experience handling inbound customer calls and making outbound sales or follow-up calls.



**3.** Describe how you would handle this situation:



*A customer calls upset because their homeowners insurance premium has increased significantly. They are frustrated and want to speak to someone immediately, but the licensed agent is unavailable. What would you say and do?*



**4.** Provide a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a great fit for this position. Please speak naturally, as if you were talking to a customer—not reading a prepared script.



**5.** Include your expected hourly rate in USD and your availability during U.S. Central Time business hours.



We are looking for someone who can become a valued, long-term member of our team. If you enjoy helping people, are comfortable making phone calls, and take pride in delivering excellent customer service, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Remote Engineering Support – CAD/BIM, Low Voltage & Fire Alarm Systems
description:
About Us

Industrial Electronic Systems, Inc. (IES) is a U.S.-based fire alarm and life safety systems company serving commercial customers in Northern California. We specialize in fire alarm design, installation, inspections, and low voltage systems integration.



About the Role

We are hiring a Remote Engineering Support specialist to help our U.S. engineering team design and document low voltage and fire alarm systems for commercial buildings. This is a hands-on engineering role — you'll model in BIM, draft in CAD, research code, and produce real deliverables for active construction projects.



We need someone who is:

• A strong CAD and BIM modeler (this is non-negotiable)

• Experienced with low voltage system design

• Comfortable with NFPA 72 / NEC code research (fire alarm experience is a big plus)

• A self-starter who can solve design challenges independently

• Detail-obsessed — drawings, layers, sheet sets, and revisions all done right

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities



CAD & BIM Engineering

• Produce 2D AutoCAD drawings — device layouts, risers, wiring diagrams, system details, and submittal sets.

• Build and maintain 3D BIM models (Revit / Navisworks) for low voltage and fire alarm systems.

• Set up sheets, viewports, title blocks, layers, and XREFs to company CAD standards.

• Coordinate clash detection and drawing updates with the broader project model.



Low Voltage & Fire Alarm Design Support

• Assist in designing NFPA-compliant fire alarm systems (device layout, spacing, placement).

• Support design of access control, intrusion, structured cabling, and other low voltage systems.

• Identify code-driven requirements — smoke/heat detector spacing, notification coverage, strobe candela placement, circuit routing and survivability.

• Review architectural and electrical drawings for design impact and coordination.



Research & Problem Solving

• Look up AHJ requirements (city/state fire department standards).

• Compare NFPA 72 / NEC requirements against local code amendments.

• Document findings and communicate design impacts to U.S. engineers.

• Identify missing information in plans and propose solutions before they become RFIs.



Submittals & Closeout

• Create submittal drawings, cut sheets, and product data packages.

• Update as-built drawings from field markups.

• Maintain version control and clean project files throughout the job lifecycle.

________________________________________

Required Qualifications

• Strong AutoCAD 2D skills (layers, XREFs, sheet sets, scaling) — required.

• Strong BIM skills in Revit and/or Navisworks — required.

• Solid understanding of low voltage systems (fire alarm, access control, security, structured cabling).

• Fire alarm experience is a big plus — NFPA 72, NEC, AHJ familiarity preferred.

• Ability to read and interpret architectural, mechanical, and electrical plans.

• Strong analytical skills and willingness to research code/AHJ requirements.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Reliable workstation, stable internet, and willingness to overlap with U.S. Pacific Time.

title: AI UGC & Animated Ads Specialist
description:
ABOUT US

We run a growing group of direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands in skincare, supplements, wellness and lifestyle, selling across the US, Canada and the UK. Our growth depends on ad creative that stops the scroll. We're looking for a creator who uses the newest AI video tools to turn out high-converting UGC-style ads and animated ads quickly and in volume.



THE ROLE

You'll make AI-generated ad creative from start to finish for Meta, TikTok, YouTube and Google: realistic AI UGC testimonials, animated character ads, and animated music/jingle ads. You'll write the scripts, generate the visuals and voices, edit, and deliver many variations ready to test, then improve them based on how they perform.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Make AI UGC ads: realistic AI avatars and influencers giving testimonials, unboxings, "problem → solution" demos and reaction-style videos

- Make animated ads: 2D/3D-style character animation, explainer animations and motion-graphic product ads

- Make animated song ads: catchy jingles and short music-video ads with on-screen animation synced to the lyrics

- Use Claude and Grok for scripts, hooks, angles and prompts, and run production through Higgsfield, HeyGen, Kie.ai and similar tools

- Write hooks and ad scripts using proven direct-response formats (hook → problem → solution → proof → CTA)

- Produce several variations per concept (hooks, avatars, voiceovers, aspect ratios 9:16 / 1:1 / 4:5 / 16:9) for creative testing

- Edit final cuts with captions, sound design, music, b-roll and brand-safe on-screen text

- Keep characters and products consistent across scenes and campaigns

- Stay current on new AI video, image and audio models, and bring new formats to the team

- Work with our media buyers and use performance data (hook rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) to guide new creative



TOOLS YOU'LL USE (ALL PROVIDED BY US)

We cover all software and subscriptions, including Claude, Grok, Higgsfield, HeyGen and Kie.ai, plus any other AI tools the role needs.



MUST-HAVES

- Proven experience creating AI UGC ads and animated ads for e-commerce or DTC brands

- Hands-on experience with AI video/avatar tools (Higgsfield, HeyGen, Kling, Veo, Runway, Sora or similar)

- Experience making animated song or jingle ads with AI music tools (Suno, Udio, ElevenLabs or similar)

- Strong prompt-writing skills across LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok) and image/video models

- Good video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or DaVinci Resolve)

- A clear grasp of direct-response advertising: what makes a hook work and why an ad converts

- Ability to produce high volume fast without dropping quality

- Strong written English for scripts and captions

- Reliable, self-managed and responsive across time zones



NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience with AI voice cloning and lip-sync (ElevenLabs, HeyGen)

- Motion graphics or 2D/3D animation background

- Experience with TikTok Shop or Meta ad creative testing

- Knowledge of platform ad policies (Meta, TikTok, Google), especially for health and beauty

- Experience with AI image tools (Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Higgsfield Soul) for product shots and static ads



HOW TO APPLY (REQUIRED)

Applications without work samples won't be considered. Please include:

1. A portfolio or links to at least 3–5 AI-generated ads you've made, with at least one AI UGC ad, one animated ad and one animated song/jingle ad

2. A short note on which tools you used for each sample

3. Any results you can share (ROAS, CTR, spend scaled, etc.)

4. Your availability and expected rate

title: Performance Creative Designer — Static Ads
description:
We are looking for a Performance Graphic Designer to create high-converting static ads for a fast-growing DTC beauty brand.



This role is focused on direct-response advertising — not general branding or organic social media design.



You should be able to understand a creative brief, identify the correct information hierarchy and visual format, and independently turn the strategy into a strong static ad designed for paid social.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

• Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

• Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

• Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

• Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

• Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.





REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

• Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

• Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

• Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

• Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

• Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

• Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

• Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

• Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus. 



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE REQUIREMENTS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please include the following:



1. Your portfolio link, preferably including direct-response static ads for paid social.

2. If you have worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands, please specify the brand names and include links to relevant work.

3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

4. What is your current work situation? Are you employed full-time, working part-time, freelancing, or currently available?

5. When would you be available to start if selected?

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

7. What design tools do you regularly use? Please specify your experience with Figma and/or Photoshop.

8. What AI image-generation or editing tools do you use? Briefly explain how you use them in your workflow.

9. From a clear creative brief with the necessary assets provided, how many NET-NEW STATIC AD CONCEPTS can you normally complete in one working day?

10. From an existing concept or winning ad, how many MEANINGFUL VARIATIONS can you normally complete in one working day?



Please do not count simple resizes or format adaptations as new creatives.



11. How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

12. Briefly explain how you would take one winning static ad and turn it into multiple genuinely different variations for further testing.



IMPORTANT



This role is specifically focused on performance advertising.



We are looking for designers who understand that a strong paid-social creative is not just visually attractive — it must communicate the right message quickly, establish a clear hierarchy, and support the intended conversion goal.



Applications without a relevant static-ad portfolio may not be considered.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for Clinics (English) | 800 USD/month + Bonus
description:
Hi! I'm William, founder of VisualFlow, a software company based in Miami. We build small clinics a website with online booking and a simple system that keeps track of every client and follows up for them. We're growing fast, and I'm looking for the first cold caller who grows with us.



I want a machine on the phone 💪 Someone with real energy, who loves talking to people, doesn't get shaken by a "no", and gets excited when the calendar fills up. If you've ever finished a shift and thought "I could have booked more," this is for you.



THE JOB

You call clinic owners and book them into a 15-minute call with me. You don't sell and you never quote prices. You start a real conversation, find out how new clients book with them, and book the call. I take it from there.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Make 150 to 200 calls a day from our CRM dialer, with a script I give you and train you on personally

- Read the short note we prepare on each clinic before you dial

- Have short, friendly, confident conversations with clinic owners

- Book interested owners into my calendar

- Log every call and note in the CRM

- A 10-minute check-in every day in week 1, then one 30-minute call a week where we listen to your calls and level you up



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Great energy. People can hear your smile on the phone.

- Clear, confident, natural English. Non-negotiable.

- Cold calling or appointment setting experience, ideally calling North American businesses

- Hungry to grow, and you take feedback and use it the same day

- Quiet room, good headset, stable internet, backup power

- Available Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time (night shift in the Philippines)



PAY AND GROWTH

- 800 USD per month, paid weekly every Friday (about 185 USD per week)

- 10 USD bonus for every booked call that shows up, no cap

- 50 USD bonus for every clinic that becomes a client from your calls, no cap

- If you perform, your pay goes up as the results come in

- The best performer becomes the one who trains the next callers



HOW THE FIRST MONTH WORKS

The first month is a paid trial. You're paid every Friday for that week's hours. Every Friday we review your numbers and calls together, and either of us can end it at the end of any week. Hit the targets and the role becomes permanent after the first month, with a raise.



WHY JOIN US

We're a small, hungry team that moves fast. No corporate layers, you work directly with the founder, and your results are seen every single week. If you want to grow with a company that's just getting started, this is the seat.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Record a short video (Loom, or a Google Drive link), face on camera, max 90 seconds:

   - First, read this as if you were on a real call: "Hi, is this Sarah? Hi Sarah, this is [your name] from VisualFlow. I'll be quick, I know you're between clients. I tried to book with you online last night and couldn't find a way to do it. Can I ask, when someone finds you on Google at 9pm, how do they usually book with you?"

   - Then, in your own words and without a script, tell me about the best appointment you ever booked on a cold call.

2. In 3 lines, tell me your cold calling experience: who you called, how many calls a day, and what you booked.

3. Start your application with the word CLINIC so I know you read this far.



Applications without a video won't be reviewed. Shortlisted applicants do a live 10-minute role-play call with me, camera on. Can't wait to meet you!

title: Real Estate Pricing Analyst
description:

Job Description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Real Estate Pricing Analyst. This role will be critical in acquiring and evaluating land deals, analyzing comparable properties, researching markets, and gathering data..



This is a long-term, full-time position. You will be working directly with our U.S. team during eastern business hours.



Responsibilities:



- Research and evaluate vacant land properties as they come into our pipeline

- Search and analyze comparable land sales to determine market value

- Create accurate offer ranges and maximum allowable offer (MAO) to buy profitably

- Assess deal spreads, margins, and risk

- Review the property details such as size, topography, flood zones, access, utilities, etc.

- Set follow up tasks and notes in Salesforce for our Acquisitions Manager

- Market analysis and research

- Scrub and clean data

- Price properties using guidelines

- Format excel spreadsheets for direct mail campaigns

- Coordinate with title companies, buyers, sellers, and attorneys

- Create and follow SOPs and checklists

- Communicate clearly and effectively with the team

- Perform due diligence tasks such as ordering photography, land surveys, soil tests, calling utility companies and counties

- Miscellaneous real estate-based tasks



Qualifications:



- Experience with real estate, specifically vacant land and land pricing

- Strong analytical and research skills (Google Maps, Zillow, Redfin, LandID, County GIS, etc.)

- High attention to detail and accuracy in reporting

- Strong spoken English with minimal accent to communicate effectively with US-based clients

- High energy with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

- Takes full ownership

- Follows checklists

- Meets deadlines

- Communicate clearly

- Ability to learn and work independently

- Proficient in Excel

- Dependable internet connection and a quiet work environment



Soft Skills needed:



- Strong and fluent in speaking and writing English

- Detail orientated

- Kind and empathetic



Working Hours:



Must be available between 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM Eastern Time

No other jobs are to be worked during this time. Working another job will result in immediate dismissal.



Pay:



- Base Salary between $4/hr-$6/hr (depending on experience)

Record a 3-5 minute Loom video with an introduction of yourself, then answer the following questions:

Send your resume to 
 highlighting your experience with real estate (land), dispositions, and investors/buyers.
