title: Senior AI Ecommerce Designer, Amazon Listings and Ads
description:
ABOUT US



We sell pet products across several brands on Amazon, Chewy, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and through retail partners like Petco and Costco. We are looking for a Senior AI Ecommerce Designer to own the images that sell those products.



Your work d
 whether a shopper clicks and whether they buy. You will design Amazon and Chewy listing images, A+ Content, Brand Stories, storefronts, marketplace assets, Amazon ad creative, and landing pages. We measure your work by click-through rate and conversion rate, not by how it looks in a portfolio.



This role is for a designer who already uses AI every day. You will combine Photoshop and Illustrator with generative AI tools to concept, stage, and composite photorealistic product images in hours, not weeks. We need speed and volume, but neither is an excuse for generic work.



Pay: USD 1,500-2,000 per month

Schedule: US PST

Reports to: Creative Director, who sets weekly priorities. You will work closely with our Video Editor, Social Media Manager, and brand managers.



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF



AI is not already part of your daily design workflow. This is a requirement.

Your work depends on templates, Canva layouts, or stock mockups.

You submit raw AI generations without retouching and compositing.

You need a week to deliver what a strong AI workflow can deliver in a day.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Marketplace Assets



Design Amazon main images that follow Amazon’s white background and product fill rules while standing out in search results.

Build full secondary image sets: benefit infographics, feature callouts, size charts, comparison charts, materials and ingredient visuals, lifestyle scenes, and in-use images.

Design Premium A+ and standard A+ modules, Brand Story carousels, and Brand Storefront pages.

Create Chewy listing images and rich content to Chewy’s specs.

Adapt assets for Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and retail partner requirements.

Design mobile-first. Every image must read clearly at thumbnail size on a phone.

Deliver multiple variations of main images and A+ Content for split testing, and use the results to shape the next round.

Audit and refresh underperforming listings using click-through and conversion data from the brand managers.



Amazon Ads and Landing Pages



Design Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display creative, Amazon Posts, and seasonal, deal, and promo graphics.

Deliver ad variations for testing and refresh creative as performance data comes in.

Design landing pages and Shopify product pages as full desktop and mobile mockups, with exported assets ready for our Shopify team to build.

Keep messaging and visuals consistent from ad to listing to landing page.



AI Workflow and Compositing



Use generative AI to explore several creative directions quickly before committing to one.

Generate photorealistic lifestyle scenes (homes, yards, apartments, balconies, pets in real settings) and composite our real products into them with correct lighting, shadows, perspective, scale, and color.

Replace, extend, and clean up backgrounds using Photoshop Generative Fill, Firefly, Flux, or similar tools.

Upscale and enhance images with Magnific or similar tools without adding artifacts.

Fix AI errors before anything ships: pet anatomy, paws, eyes, fur edges, warped geometry, garbled text, and incorrect product details.

Work from any source assets we have (studio photos, supplier images, 3D files, basic product shots) and flag when a reshoot is needed.

Build and maintain prompt libraries, style references, and scene templates to keep output consistent across brands.

Test new AI tools as they launch and recommend the ones that make the team faster or better.



Brand Consistency and Compliance



Keep each brand visually distinct while following its typography, color, and tone guidelines.

Keep products accurate in every image. AI must never change the size, color, texture, components, or packaging of what the customer receives.

Follow Amazon, Chewy, Walmart, and TikTok Shop image and content policies, including rules on claims, badges, and comparisons.

Use only product claims approved by the brand managers.

Use only AI tools and assets licensed for commercial use.

Keep organized, layered source files with clear naming and version control in our shared drive.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Design Fundamentals



4+ years of professional graphic design experience, with at least 2 years designing Amazon listing images and A+ Content.

Expert-level Photoshop and Illustrator, including advanced masking, color matching, compositing, and high-end retouching.

Strong typography. You pair fonts with intention, build clear hierarchy, and avoid generic or dated type.

Strong command of layout, grids, color, and visual hierarchy, including desktop and mobile landing pages.

Ability to turn a product benefit into a visual a shopper understands in 3 seconds, without a wall of text.

Working knowledge of what drives marketplace conversion: scannable benefits, objection handling, comparison framing, and image sequence.

Clear written English for on-image copy and daily work with a US-based team.



AI Prompting and Retouching



At least 1 year of daily, hands-on use of generative AI in professional design work.

Fluency with Midjourney, Photoshop Generative Fill and Firefly, Flux, Magnific, or similar tools.

Ability to control AI output: style and image references, inpainting and outpainting, seeds, and pose or composition control.

Ability to composite real products into AI scenes so the final image reads as a real photo.

A trained eye for AI artifacts and the retouching skill to fix them.

Ability to explain your workflow step by step and how much time AI saves you at each stage.



Nice to Have



Pet product or consumer packaged goods experience.

Experience with Amazon split testing (Manage Your Experiments), Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display creative, or reading click-through and conversion data.

3D rendering experience (Blender, KeyShot, or similar).

Basic motion or video skills to support our Video Editor.

Figma experience for templates and design systems.



PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS



Applications without a portfolio that includes ALL of the following will not be reviewed:



At least 2 complete Amazon listing image sets (main image plus full secondary carousel) that you designed.

At least 1 full A+ or Premium A+ Content project showing the complete module stack.

At least 1 landing page or ecommerce product page design, shown for desktop and mobile.

At least 3 before-and-after AI compositing examples. For each, show the original source photo, the raw AI generation, and your final image, with a short note on tools used and time spent.

Results where available, such as click-through or conversion lift or a split test outcome. If you are under NDA, explain what you changed and why.

Your role on each project: sole designer, lead, or part of a team.



Live Amazon or Chewy product links are welcome. Portfolios built mainly on templates, stock mockups, or unedited AI output will not move forward.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application through OLJ with:



A link to your portfolio (Google Drive, Behance, or personal site). Make sure the link is set to public.

A short note on which piece in your portfolio you are most proud of and why.

Start your message with the words “SCROLL STOPPER” so we know you read the full post.



Applications that skip any of these will not be reviewed.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Motion Graphics and Effects)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We sell pet products across several brands on Amazon, Chewy, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and through retail partners. We are looking for an inventive, trend-savvy short-form video editor to create scroll-stopping, high-converting video for all of our brands.



You will turn raw phone footage from our in-house team and content creators into organic TikToks and Reels, product videos for Amazon, Chewy, and TikTok Shop, and paid social and Amazon Sponsored Brands video ads.



You won’t just be cutting clips together. You will add creative flair, dynamic masking, kinetic transitions, and sound design to make simple clips feel clever and fun. You should be fluent in TikTok and IG culture, native trend formats, and creative visual editing tricks.



We work AI-first. You should already use AI features in your editing tools (for example, DaVinci Resolve Magic Mask or CapCut auto cutout) to work faster without lowering quality.



Pay: USD 1,500 to 2,000 per month, depending on experience

Schedule: 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM PST

Reports to: Creative Director. You will work day to day with our Social Media Manager and other marketing managers.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Organic Social Video (about 20 hours per week)



Edit 9:16 vertical videos for TikTok and Instagram Reels using raw footage from our in-house social team and content creators.

Apply creative visual effects, including dynamic rotoscoping and masking (sticker peel effects, freeze-frame cutouts, object pop-ins), seamless jump cuts, disappearing and appearing object tricks, match cuts, native collage, paper tear, 2D sticker animations, and seamless loops built for replay value.

Time cuts, transitions, text animations, and effects precisely to the beat of the music.

Design on-screen text with a refined eye: choose and pair fonts, set clear hierarchy and spacing, keep text within platform safe zones, and animate it so it looks polished and premium, not template-based.

Add trending audio licensed for business accounts, sound effects, animated captions, and platform-native text styles.

Bring your own ideas for hooks, pacing, and trend formats instead of only assembling footage.



Marketplace Video (about 10 hours per week)



Create product videos for Amazon (listing and A+ Content), Chewy, and other channels.

Adapt content to each platform’s formats, including 16:9, 1:1, and 9:16.

Follow each retailer’s content guidelines, with clear product benefits and demonstrations.



Paid Ads (about 15 hours per week)



Edit video ads for Meta, TikTok, and Amazon Sponsored Brands.

Produce multiple hook and format variations of each concept for testing.



AI Workflow



Use AI tools throughout your workflow to speed up turnaround, such as AI masking and rotoscoping, auto captions, beat detection, and rough cut assembly, while keeping full creative control of the final edit.

Generate and edit video and visual assets with AI tools such as Seedance, Higgsfield, and Claude, and blend them with live footage.



Across All Work



Manage a steady weekly queue of requests from the Creative Director, Social Media Manager, and marketing managers.

Keep project files organized and deliver final exports in the correct specs for each platform.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



A portfolio of TikTok and Reels edits with creative transitions, masking, and visual tricks. Talking-head videos with subtitles will not be considered.

A precise sense of rhythm. Your edits land on the beat, not near it.

Strong typography and design sense, including font pairing, hierarchy, spacing, color contrast, and adapting text style to different brand identities.



Required



Working proficiency in both CapCut and DaVinci Resolve. Our team uses both for project handoffs.

Advanced motion graphics and effects skills in at least one professional tool, such as After Effects, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve (Fusion), or CapCut Pro.

Hands-on experience with AI video tools such as Seedance, Higgsfield, or similar.

A strong ear for sound design and audio syncing.

Deep familiarity with current TikTok and Reels trends and humor formats.

Fluent written and spoken English for daily work with a US-based team.

Ability to manage a full weekly queue and meet turnaround times.



Nice to Have



Experience creating product videos for Amazon, Chewy, or TikTok Shop.

Experience editing paid social or Amazon Sponsored Brands video ads.

Ecommerce or consumer products experience.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application through OLJ with:



Links to 3 to 5 short-form videos you edited that show creative transitions, rotoscoping or masking tricks, or seamless loops. At least one must show beat-synced editing, and at least one must show custom on-screen typography. For each link, add one sentence naming the effect or technique you built, the software you used, and whether it shows beat-syncing or typography.

Any product, marketplace, or ad videos you have edited, if available.

Your main editing and motion graphics software, the AI tools you use, and one example of how AI shortened your turnaround on a specific video.

Your current availability and typical turnaround time per video.

Start your message with the words “ON THE BEAT” so we know you read the full post.



Make sure all links are set to public. Applications that skip any of these will not be reviewed.

title: Project Cost Engineer / Assistant Project Manager
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME AND A VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Project Cost Engineer / Assistant Project Manager



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break



Job Overview: 

We are seeking a proactive and analytical Project Cost Engineer / Assistant Project Manager with hands-on construction industry experience, preferably in architectural sheet metal, aluminum composite material (ACM) panels, exterior cladding, or building envelope systems. The ideal candidate must have experience using Sage 300 CRE and Procore to monitor project costs, track field productivity, and evaluate financial performance.



This role combines construction cost engineering with project management support, focusing on cost control, labor productivity, cost-to-complete forecasting, and early identification of potential cost overruns. The ideal candidate understands construction operations, can interpret financial and field-production data, and proactively recommends corrective actions to protect project profitability.



Key Responsibilities:

* Monitor project budgets, actual costs, purchase orders, subcontract commitments, and remaining costs for architectural sheet metal, ACM panel, exterior cladding, and building envelope projects.

* Reconcile Sage 300 CRE financial data with Procore daily reports, labor hours, installed quantities, and project progress.

* Analyze labor productivity and compare actual performance against estimated production rates to identify inefficiencies.

* Prepare realistic cost-to-complete forecasts and flag projects trending over budget before substantial losses occur.

* Review field reports for extra work, scope changes, delays, and potential change orders; organize supporting documentation for project manager review.

* Assist with purchase orders, subcontract commitments, cost coding, project documentation, and other assistant project management duties.

* Provide concise morning summaries and weekly reports highlighting budget variances, productivity concerns, outstanding issues, potential change orders, and recommended corrective actions.

* Coordinate with accounting, project managers, and field teams to investigate discrepancies and obtain missing information.

Improve reporting through Excel, automation, and appropriate AI tools, verifying accuracy against source records.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or Industrial Engineering required.

* Relevant experience in construction cost engineering, project controls, or subcontractor cost management.

* Direct experience with architectural sheet metal, ACM panels, exterior cladding, or building envelope construction strongly preferred.

* Hands-on proficiency in Sage 300 CRE, including job costing, purchase orders, commitments, and budget tracking.

* Hands-on proficiency in Procore, including daily reports, labor hours, project progress, documentation, and change orders.

* Strong understanding of construction installation methods, labor productivity, cost forecasting, and change-order documentation.

* Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup formulas, and financial reconciliations.

* Ability to read construction drawings, specifications, estimates, and scope documents; Bluebeam experience preferred.

* Proactive and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies, ask informed questions, and recommend practical solutions independently.

* Strong written and spoken English.

* Availability to work 7:00 AM–4:00 PM Pacific Time.



****Applicants must clearly disclose if they lack experience with Sage 300 CRE or Procore. Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical technical assessment****



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Financial Operations Coordinator
description:
Financial Operations Coordinator (Part-Time)



Company: Plush Rose a Blowout Bar Salon Inc.

Location: Remote

Hours: Approximately 15 hours per week



About Us



Plush Rose a Blowout Bar Salon Inc. is an established and growing beauty company based in the United States, with multiple salon locations and plans for continued expansion.



We’re looking for a reliable, organized, and detail-oriented Financial Operations Coordinator to help us stay on top of our daily business finances, expenses, budgets, and financial records.



We already have an accountant and bookkeeper, so we’re not looking for someone to take over those responsibilities. Instead, we need someone who can help us stay organized between accounting periods, keep our financial information up to date, and make sure important details don’t get overlooked.



We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through, and genuinely enjoys keeping things organized.



Key Responsibilities



Expense Tracking & Budget Management



* Review and organize daily business expenses and purchases.

* Ensure expenses are assigned to the correct business location and budget category.

* Update and maintain our budgets in Oliv.

* Monitor spending and identify when expenses are approaching or exceeding budget.

* Organize receipts, invoices, and supporting documentation.

* Follow up on missing information or transactions that need clarification.



Cash Flow & Financial Organization



* Help monitor available cash and upcoming financial obligations.

* Maintain a calendar of bills, recurring payments, and due dates.

* Track expected income and expenses to help us plan ahead.

* Identify potential cash-flow concerns and bring them to management’s attention.

* Keep financial information current so ownership can make informed decisions.



Sales & Reporting



* Review daily sales reports from our salon management software, Meevo.

* Help track sales, deposits, and expenses by business location.

* Identify discrepancies or missing financial information.

* Prepare simple daily and weekly financial summaries.

* Provide clear updates on spending, budgets, upcoming bills, and outstanding items.



Accounting Support & Communication



* Work alongside our existing bookkeeper and accounting team.

* Assist with reviewing and organizing transaction information in Xero.

* Make sure necessary receipts and supporting documents are available.

* Communicate with management when transactions require clarification.

* Follow up on outstanding financial items until they’re resolved.



Systems We Use



Our company currently uses:



* Oliv: Budgeting and cash-flow management

* Meevo: Salon management and sales reporting

* Xero: Accounting and financial records



Experience with Xero is strongly preferred. Experience with Oliv or Meevo is not required, but applicants must be comfortable learning new systems.



We prefer to work with our existing software rather than introduce additional platforms.



Qualifications



* At least 2 years of experience in financial administration, bookkeeping support, expense tracking, or a related position.

* Familiarity with budgeting, cash flow, and basic accounting principles.

* Experience using Xero is strongly preferred.

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

* Comfortable working with spreadsheets and financial reports.

* Good written and verbal English communication skills.

* Ability to manage responsibilities independently and meet deadlines.

* Experience supporting U.S.-based businesses is a plus.

* Experience working with multiple business locations is a plus.



The Person We’re Looking For



We value consistency, honesty, communication, and accountability.



We’re looking for someone who doesn’t need to be reminded constantly to complete recurring tasks. Someone who notices when something doesn’t look right, asks questions when needed, and follows through until the issue is resolved.



You don’t need to know everything on your first day. We’re happy to explain our processes and help you become familiar with our business. What matters most is your willingness to learn, attention to detail, and ability to take ownership of your work.



Schedule & Opportunity



This is a long-term, part-time position starting at approximately 15 hours per week, with the possibility of additional hours as our business grows.



The schedule offers some flexibility, but you should be available for occasional communication during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



How to Apply



If you’re interested in joining our team, please send us:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Your experience with Xero, expense tracking, budgeting, or cash-flow management.

3. Any experience you’ve had working with U.S.-based businesses.

4. Your expected hourly rate in USD and weekly availability.

5. An example of how you’ve helped a previous employer stay financially organized.



Please begin your application with “Plush Rose Financial Coordinator” so we know you’ve read the full job description.



Qualified applicants may be invited to complete a short, paid skills assessment.



We’re looking forward to finding someone dependable who can grow with our company and become a valued part of our team.

Company: Plush Rose a Blowout Bar Salon Inc.

Employment Type: Part-Time, Long-Term

Schedule: Approximately 8–10 hours per week initially

Compensation: $6.50USD per hour



About Us



Plush Rose a Blowout Bar Salon Inc. is a growing U.S.-based salon company with locations in Georgia and Missouri.



We’re looking for a creative, experienced, and dependable Social Media & Brand Content Coordinator to help strengthen our brand, manage our social media presence, and create professional marketing materials.



We have an established brand and want someone who can help us maintain a clean, polished, and consistent appearance across our marketing platforms.



We’re not looking for someone who simply posts content. We want someone who understands branding, has a strong eye for design, brings creative ideas, and knows how to use marketing to attract new clients and increase appointment bookings.



Key Responsibilities



Social Media Management



* Manage and maintain our Instagram and
 accounts.

* Develop and organize a monthly social media content calendar.

* Create, schedule, and publish engaging posts, Reels, stories, and promotional content.

* Write professional, natural captions that reflect our brand.

* Monitor social media engagement and identify opportunities to improve our online presence.

* Maintain consistent branding across both salon locations.



Graphic Design & Branded Content



* Design clean, modern, professional graphics that reflect our established brand identity.

* Create promotional graphics for salon services, retail products, special offers, and seasonal campaigns.

* Design branded content featuring our stylists, team members, salon services, and client transformations.

* Create service spotlights, product features, informational graphics, and salon announcements.

* Edit and enhance photos and videos provided by our salon teams.

* Create short-form video content and Reels using CapCut or similar editing software.

* Develop reusable branded templates for consistent marketing materials.

* Assist with designing digital flyers, promotional signage, and other marketing materials as needed.



Our preferred design style is clean, elevated, modern, and professional, similar to the polished branding seen in established beauty and salon brands.



We do not want generic templates, cluttered graphics, or content that looks overly AI-generated.



Marketing & Business Growth



* Develop creative marketing ideas to attract new clients and encourage repeat visits.

* Plan promotional campaigns highlighting salon services, products, and appointment availability.

* Help promote online booking and increase awareness of our locations.

* Assist with
 and text marketing campaigns when needed.

* Support Google Business Profile updates and online reputation management.

* Research beauty industry marketing trends and recommend ideas appropriate for our brand.



Organization & Reporting



* Maintain an organized digital library of photos, videos, graphics, and marketing materials.

* Coordinate with salon managers to collect photos, videos, and other content.

* Track social media performance, engagement, and marketing results.

* Provide brief weekly updates on completed work, upcoming content, and recommendations.



Qualifications



* Minimum of 3 years of experience in social media management, graphic design, digital marketing, or a related role.

* Strong graphic design skills with a portfolio demonstrating clean, professional branded content.

* Proficient in Canva, CapCut, and Meta Business Suite.

* Experience managing Instagram and
 business accounts.

* Ability to create polished promotional graphics, social media content, and short-form videos.

* Strong understanding of branding, visual consistency, and marketing strategy.

* Excellent written English and strong communication skills.

* Experience working with U.S.-based businesses is preferred.

* Previous experience with salons, beauty brands, wellness companies, or service-based businesses is a plus.

* Organized, dependable, creative, and comfortable working independently.



Who We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who has a genuine eye for design and understands how to make a brand look professional and consistent.



You should be able to take a simple service, product, or salon photo and turn it into attractive, branded marketing content.



We value creativity, attention to detail, initiative, and the ability to bring ideas to the table rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions.



Our goal is to find someone who can take ownership of our social media content and help us build a stronger, more recognizable brand while supporting business growth.



Schedule & Compensation



* Part-time, approximately 8–10 hours per week initially.

* $6.00 USD per hour.

* Flexible schedule with some availability during U.S. business hours for communication.

* Long-term opportunity with potential for additional hours as the company grows.



How to Apply



Please include the following:



1. A brief summary of your social media management, marketing, and graphic design experience.

2. A portfolio showing branded graphics, promotional materials, and social media content you have personally created.

3. Links to social media accounts you currently manage or have previously managed.

4. Your experience creating content for beauty, salon, wellness, or other service-based businesses.

5. The design, video editing, and social media management tools you use.

6. Your availability and confirmation that the advertised hourly rate works for you.



A portfolio is required. We are especially interested in applicants who can demonstrate clean, professional, visually consistent branding.



We’re looking for someone who can bring creativity, organization, and fresh marketing ideas to our growing company.



If you enjoy creating beautiful branded content and helping businesses grow through effective marketing, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Instagram DM Setter / Recruiting Appointment Setter
description:
We are a fast-growing U.S.-based life insurance agency looking for a highly motivated DM Setter to help us recruit new insurance agents and salespeople through Instagram.



Your primary responsibility will be to have conversations inside Instagram DMs, qualify potential candidates, and book qualified prospects onto our recruiting calendar.



This is NOT a social media posting position.



Your job is to start conversations, follow up, handle basic objections, create interest, and BOOK CALLS.



What You’ll Be Doing

Respond to people who engage with our Instagram content and recruiting ads

Start conversations with potential insurance agents and salespeople

Send outbound DMs to qualified prospects

Follow our recruiting DM scripts and conversation framework

Ask qualifying questions to determine whether someone is a good fit

Explain our opportunity at a high level without over-selling through DMs

Move qualified prospects toward booking a recruiting call

Send calendar links and confirm appointments

Follow up with prospects who stop responding

Follow up with people who are interested but haven't booked yet

Keep conversations organized and make sure leads do not fall through the cracks

Update prospect information and appointment status inside our CRM/tracking system

Communicate daily with our recruiting and management team

Your Main Goal



Book qualified recruiting calls onto our calendar every day.



We are not looking for someone who simply sends messages.



We want someone who understands that their job is to move conversations forward and turn interested prospects into appointments.



What We're Looking For



You should be:



Extremely comfortable communicating through Instagram DMs

Fluent in written English

Able to write naturally and conversationally

Fast at responding

Persistent with follow-up without sounding annoying

Comfortable handling objections

Comfortable starting conversations with strangers

Organized and detail-oriented

Competitive and motivated by numbers

Coachable and willing to follow scripts/processes

Able to work independently

Reliable and consistent

Comfortable being measured based on performance



Previous experience with any of the following is highly preferred:



DM setting

Appointment setting

Recruiting

Sales

Lead generation

Instagram outreach

High-ticket sales

Insurance recruiting

How Performance Will Be Measured



Your performance will primarily be measured by:



Number of conversations started

Response rate

Follow-up activity

Qualified prospects generated

Recruiting calls booked

Show rate

Quality of appointments booked



We care about quality AND volume.



Booking 20 unqualified people is not better than booking 10 great candidates who actually show up and are interested.



Schedule



This is a remote position.



You should be available during U.S. Eastern Time hours, especially during the times when our prospects are most active.



Some flexibility may be required because Instagram conversations can happen throughout the day.



Who Will Do Well In This Role



You will probably do very well if you are someone who:



Likes talking to people

Enjoys sales and persuasion

Is naturally competitive

Doesn't get discouraged when people don't respond

Understands the importance of following up multiple times

Can manage hundreds of conversations without becoming disorganized

Wants to grow into a larger sales, recruiting, or leadership role

How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself

Your previous experience with DM setting, appointment setting, recruiting, or sales

How many DM conversations you believe you could realistically manage per day

Your experience booking appointments

Your expected hourly rate

A screenshot or example of previous appointment-setting results if available

A short voice recording introducing yourself



Also answer this question:



If someone responds to a recruiting DM with “I'm interested, but I'm already with another insurance agency,” what would you say back?



Please start your application with the words:



“DM SETTER”



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term position and wants to become extremely good at recruiting through social media.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable for fulfilling this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM EST (8 PM to 4 AM MNL)

4 PM to 12 AM EST (4 AM to 12 PM MNL)



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 8% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

title: Part-Time Administrative/Recruiter Specialist
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME AND A VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Part-Time Administrative/Recruiter Specialist

Job Type: Part-Time (30 scheduled hours per week; 5 hours/day, 6 days/week, weekends included)

Work Hours: Exact shift and rest days to be confirmed.



Job Overview:

We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and technologically savvy Part-Time Administrative/Recruiter Specialist to support driver recruitment and HR-related administrative activities for a transportation company. The primary focus of this role is recruitment support, particularly reviewing driver applications, contacting applicants, conducting initial screening calls, and maintaining consistent communication throughout the hiring process.



In addition to recruitment responsibilities, the position will assist with hiring documentation, employee records management, and i
 reporting. This includes collecting required employee documents, maintaining organized personnel files, following up on missing information, retrieving records when requested, and contacting employees to obtain i
 reports or additional details when needed.



The ideal candidate has previous administrative and recruiting experience, basic Microsoft Excel skills, and the confidence to make outbound calls, ask screening questions, and follow up with applicants and employees. Strong communication, urgency, attention to detail, and follow-through are essential. Candidates must be comfortable taking initiative, managing information accurately, and working independently while following the client's established procedures.



Experience in transportation, trucking, logistics, or driver recruitment is preferred. Spanish proficiency is also preferred but is not required. The candidate should be willing to learn the client's recruitment processes, documentation requirements, and applicable HR procedures across different states.





Key Responsibilities:

Administrative Support

* Maintain organized employee files, company records, and documents.

* Prepare correspondence, reports, forms, and spreadsheets.

* Communicate with employees, vendors, and service providers and track deadlines and outstanding tasks.

* Maintain accurate personnel, recruitment, and administrative records.

* Collect, organize, and follow up on missing, incomplete, or outdated employee documentation.

* Assist with i
 reporting by contacting employees, collecting reports, and obtaining additional information when needed.

* Retrieve employee or company records when requested.

* Handle employee, applicant, and company information confidentially.



Driver Recruitment & Onboarding

* Post job openings, review driver applications, and organize applicant information.

* Contact applicants, conduct initial screening calls, and assess candidates against established hiring criteria.

* Coordinate interviews and maintain applicant information in Paycom or other designated recruiting systems.

* Follow up with applicants regarding unanswered calls, missing information, pending responses, and outstanding requirements.

* Coordinate pre-employment screenings, offer letters, hiring paperwork, orientation, and training.

* Maintain accurate hiring records and keep HR and management informed of hiring progress and outstanding requirements.

* Escalate recruitment issues or candidates requiring management review.



DOT Compliance Support

* Maintain Driver Qualification (DQ) files and driver compliance records.

* Track renewals, licenses, certifications, credentials, and compliance deadlines.

* Notify drivers and management of upcoming deadlines, missing documents, and expired credentials.

* Coordinate DOT physicals, drug and alcohol testing, and driver screenings as assigned.

* Assist with FMCSA Clearinghouse queries as assigned.

* Support HOS audits, DVIR reviews, and safety-event follow-up with dispatch and management.

* Assist with compliance audit preparation and track required corrections, training, and coaching.

* Escalate missing documentation, expired credentials, or potential compliance concerns.



Vehicle Maintenance Coordination

* Coordinate vehicle maintenance and repairs with drivers, dispatch, management, and service providers.

* Track preventive maintenance, reported defects, repairs, and service records.

* Follow up on outstanding maintenance issues and unresolved vehicle concerns.

* Update dispatch and upper management regarding vehicle availability and unresolved safety concerns.

* Maintain accurate maintenance and service documentation.



Systems & Reporting

* Use Microsoft Word, Excel, and
 for administrative, recruitment, reporting, and documentation tasks.

* Maintain accurate recruitment, employee, compliance, and maintenance tracking records.

* Learn and use systems such as Paycom, Samsara, and Trax, as applicable.

* Respond promptly to calls, messages, and internal requests related to assigned responsibilities.

* Escalate issues requiring management review and follow established company procedures.



Required Qualifications

* Previous administrative experience required.

* Previous recruiting, talent acquisition, or recruitment coordination experience required.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

* Confidence in making outbound calls and conducting initial applicant screening.

* Strong organization, attention to detail, follow-up, and time-management skills.

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and
.

* Ability to maintain accurate records and manage multiple deadlines independently.

* Ability to handle confidential employee and applicant information professionally and discreetly.

* Strong computer literacy and ability to learn new systems and digital tools.

* Ability to work independently and effectively with HR, dispatch, management, employees, applicants, vendors, and service providers.

* Ability to adapt to changing operational needs and priorities.

* Willingness to learn the client's recruitment, HR, DOT compliance, and documentation procedures.



Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in transportation, trucking, logistics, or commercial driver recruiting.

* Familiarity with DOT compliance and driver records.

* Experience with Driver Qualification files, DOT physicals, drug and alcohol testing, Clearinghouse, HOS, DVIRs, or safety-event follow-up.

* Experience coordinating vehicle maintenance, repairs, preventive maintenance, or service records.

* Experience with Paycom, Samsara, and/or Trax.

* Previous HR administrative experience involving employee files, onboarding, hiring documentation, compliance records, or i
 reporting.

* Experience with high-volume applicant outreach or phone-based screening.

* Spanish proficiency is preferred but not required.



Working Conditions

* Frequent computer and telephone use with regular communication with employees, applicants, management, vendors, and service providers.

* Requires accuracy, timely follow-up, confidentiality, and attention to detail.

* Requires flexibility as recruitment, compliance, maintenance, and operational needs change.

* Requires the ability to manage deadlines and work independently while collaborating with a team.

* Schedule requires 6 days per week, including weekends, aligned with Los Angeles local time.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Customer Relations/ Sales in Real Estate
description:
Job description:

Compensation:1500$ plus 0.5% of all deals closed and1% in renegotiation

Customer Relations Specialist

Location: Miami, FL -remote

Job Type: Full-Time



About Us



Solution Based Homebuyers is a fast-growing real estate investment company specializing in identifying, acquiring, and managing residential properties. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment and are expanding our Customer Relations team in Miami.



Position Overview



Once our Acquisitions team signs an agreement with a seller, the file is transferred to Customer Relations. As a Customer Relations Specialist, you will take ownership of the seller relationship and help guide the transaction from contract to closing.



Your responsibility is to maintain strong communication with the seller, keep the deal moving forward, resolve issues, and renegotiate terms when necessary to ensure the transaction remains viable.



This is not a traditional customer service position. It is a customer-facing role that combines relationship management, negotiation, sales, and problem-solving. Successful team members are confident communicators who can protect the relationship while also protecting the profitability of the deal.



Key Responsibilities



Take ownership of signed agreements transferred from the Acquisitions team



Build and maintain strong relationships with sellers throughout the transaction



Follow up consistently to keep sellers engaged and deals moving toward closing



Renegotiate pricing or contract terms when necessary



Identify and resolve issues that could delay or jeopardize a transaction



Set clear expectations with sellers regarding timelines, inspections, documentation, and next steps



Maintain accurate and detailed notes, tasks, and updates within the CRM



Coordinate closely with Acquisitions, Dispositions, Transaction Coordination, and other internal departments



Ensure smooth departmental handoffs and clear communication across every active file



Escalate high-risk files and develop solutions before issues become major problems



Work toward individual and company performance goals tied to closed and funded transactions



Qualifications



Proven sales, negotiation, account management, or relationship-management experience



Strong verbal and written communication skills



Confident handling difficult conversations and negotiating contract terms



Ability to build trust while remaining firm and solution-oriented



Highly organized and capable of managing multiple active files at the same time



Strong follow-up habits and attention to detail



Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment



Self-motivated, accountable, and results-oriented



Real estate experience is preferred but not required



Experience in real estate, solar, insurance, automotive sales, or another high-activity sales environment is a plus



What We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is competitive, organized, persuasive, and emotionally intelligent. You should be able to connect with sellers, uncover the real cause of an issue, and confidently guide the conversation toward a solution.



You must be comfortable taking ownership of your files and being held accountable for performance.



Why Join Solution Based Homebuyers?



High earning potential tied directly to deal performance



Base compensation plus commission



Clear opportunities for advancement within a growing real estate company



Hands-on training and support



Collaborative, in-office team environment



Fast-paced culture focused on execution, accountability, and results



We are hiring immediately.



Experience:



Sales: 1 year (Preferred)

Location:



Miami, FL 33133 (Preferred)

Shift availability: Monday- Saturday 



Work Location: Remote
